En LSD dream emulator, el jugador navega a través de un mundo de sueños psicodélicos. La idea es simple caminar y explorar las cosas en un entorno de ensueño. Hay muchos entornos extraños en este mundo, y una forma de viajar a través de ellos es a pie. Sin embargo, si el jugador se topa con paredes u otros objetos en el juego, serán transportados instantáneamente a otro entorno a través de un sistema llamado "vinculación". Chocarse con personas, animales u objetos especiales generalmente resulta en un sueño extraño.
Cada sueño puede durar hasta 10 minutos, después de lo cual el jugador se 'despertará', cuando la pantalla se desvanezca y el jugador vuelva al menú inicial del juego. Sin embargo, si el jugador se cae de un acantilado o cae en un agujero en el sueño, entonces el jugador se despertará de inmediato. Hay un gráfico que aparece al final de cada sueño que realiza un seguimiento del estado mental del jugador; los estados son Upper, Downer, Static y Dynamic, en referencia a los entornos y la sensación general del sueño por el que acaba de pasar el jugador. Los estados pasados ​​pueden tener efectos en sueños posteriores.

Luftwaffe is a generic German term for an air force. It is also the official name for two of the four historic German air forces, the Wehrmacht air arm founded in 1933 and disbanded in 1946; and the current Bundeswehr air arm founded in 1956.
 During World War II at the outset of the war, the Luftwaffe was one of the most modern, powerful, and experienced air forces in the world, dominating the skies over Europe with aircraft much more advanced than their foreign counterparts. The Luftwaffe was central to the German Blitzkrieg (lightning war) doctrine, as the close air support provided by various medium two-engine bombers, Stuka dive bombers and an overwhelming force of tactical fighters were key to several early successes. However, unlike the British and American Air Forces, the Luftwaffe never developed four-engine bombers in any significant numbers, and was thus unable to conduct an effective long-range strategic bombing campaign against either the Russians or the Western Allies.
 Luftwaffe - Doitsu Kuugun o Shiki Seyo puts the player as the commander of the Germany Air Force, (Luftwaffe), in the Second World War. A dynamic system in real-time moving all forces, including highlights and full of flowing 3D battle screen! Commitment propeller aircraft, ranging about 100 aircraft models accurately portrayed. The combination of aircraft and pilots, infinite variations of troops, or troops to make up any kind of player.

meta.name: Mad Panic Coaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 316.80 MB

In Mad Panic Coaster, you control a boy and a girl (perhaps a brother and sister?) as they sit in a roller coaster car and go through 15 hellish roller coasters. How these roller coasters even got past safety testing is unknown, as they don't have any rails or barriers of any sort. It's up to you to steer the roller coaster car using the d-pad to make sure it stays on the track. The roller coasters also have various monsters, traps, and jumps to avoid. To do this, you use X to jump. Hitting Square will make the girl throw some sort of yellow ball projectile that explodes at a long range, while hitting Circle will make the boy throw that same type of projectile at a shorter range. Falling off the track or getting hit by something will cost you health, and once you run out, you must start the level all over again. Once you make three laps around the track, a rainbow with the words "lucky" form around you as they come to a stop, and you move on to the next level. Every three roller coasters, a boss will be fought after completing the third lap. This boss is similar to the regular enemies, except that they take many more hits to kill. To defeat them, you has to either throw enough projectiles at them or survive another three laps.
The levels take you through a plethora of locations, ranging from scary castles to the ocean to Wonderland to the inner cities. Each roller coaster has its own unique enemies, and while the game may move too fast for you to see these enemies in close detail, pausing can show that a lot of work went into these details. Most of the game is constructed out of polygons, but the boy and girl are sprites, allowing them to appear more expressive than PS1-era polygonal characters would typically allow. The music, while slightly limited in terms of variety, is fitting for what goes on in the game, consisting mainly of instrumental thrash metal and hardcore punk tracks.

Mad Stalker: Full Metal Force es un videojuego de acción y lucha desarrollado por Fill-In Cafe y publicado por Family Soft, que se lanzó en Japón en 1997, aunque el juego ya se había lanzado previamente para FM Towns, Sharp X68000 y TurboGrafx CD.
En este juego la acción está protagonizada por robots (mechas) y se ambienta en el año 2142 d.C. Una nave de guerra es encontrada con cientos de robots a bordo conocidos como "SlaveGears", que se ponen bajo control militar. Dos de ellos, llamados “Hound Dog” y “Rising Dog”, se ponen bajo el control de la policía para uso experimental. Sin embargo, la computadora principal a bordo de la nave de guerra llamada “Omega” se activa repentinamente y accede a las redes militares, congela todas las funciones de la ciudad Artemis y le ordena a Rising Dog acabar con el enemigo. Hound Dog y su piloto, no afectados por Omega, son enviados por la policía para contrarrestar el ataque y destruir a todos los robots enemigos.
El juego presenta dos modos de juego:
-Modo Historia
-Modo Versus

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 93.66 MB

Conducting is the act of directing a musical performance by way of visible gestures. The primary duties of the conductor are to unify performers, set the tempo, execute clear preparations and beats, and to listen critically and shape the sound of the ensemble. Orchestras, choirs, concert bands and other musical ensembles often have conductors.
 An orchestra is a sizable instrumental ensemble that contains sections of string, brass, woodwind, and percussion instruments. The term orchestra derives from the Greek ????st?a, the name for the area in front of an ancient Greek stage reserved for the Greek chorus. The orchestra grew by accretion throughout the eighteenth and 19th centuries, but changed very little in composition during the course of the 20th century.
 The Maestro Music put the player in the role of an orchestra conductor armed with a conductor's baton, you take charge in guiding an orchestra or group of musicians into symphony through passage to crashing conclusion.
 Conductors daintily move their wands and band members eyeball that wand in order to play the music. Make the wrong move and discord enters the melody but flow like water and you're on your way to victory.
 The game features different music from different compositors (like Mozart or Beethoven) and the difficulty increased depending of the song. The game features also the baton stick controller to make the player feel like a real orchestra conductor.

Magic Carpet para PlayStation es una conversión de un clásico de PC. Volar sobre una alfombra es original en los videojuegos, pero el concepto y la historia lo hacen único. Recoge poderes mágicos disparando las bolas (mana) que flotan alrededor del mundo y hazlas de tu color (blanco). Luego, deja que tus globos aerostáticos los recojan y los lleven a tu castillo antes de que los otros magos tomen tu maná y lo cambien a su propio color. Hay 13 bestias diferentes que vuelan o caminan en cada uno de los 75 mundos, un aspecto realmente interesante del maná es que puedes acceder a más hechizos cuanto más obtienes, en total hay 20 hechizos diferentes que se pueden encontrar a lo largo del juego.

A board game is a game that involves counters or pieces moved or placed on a pre-marked surface or "board", according to a set of rules. Games can be based on pure strategy, chance (e.g. rolling dice) or a mixture of the two, and usually have a goal that a player aims to achieve. Early board games represented a battle between two armies, and most current board games are still based on defeating opposing players in terms of counters, winning position or accrual of points (often expressed as in-game currency).
 Magical Dice Kids is a board game in which the player (or players since the game allow up to 4 human players using the multi-tap) can play in vs or story mode in a 3d graphics board game.
 In the story mode the player controls a young kid in a 4 stage board game. To advance in the story it have to complete each stage. The gameplay is the usual in a board game, each player got a turn to roll the dice and advance through the board, in some squares there are different events, shops and items.

Data East consiguió en 1996, un enorme éxito con Magical Drop II. De aspecto similar a Bust-A-Move de Taito, ofrecía cambios en la jugabilidad que lo hacían sumamente entretenido. En una industria con tanta competencia, era imperativo aprovechar el filón, y la empresa no tardó en programar una tercera parte para la placa Neo Geo, en un acertado intento de mantener el éxito cosechado hasta entonces.
Magical Drop III ve la luz en 1997, y nos trae lo mejor de esa segunda parte, eliminando alguna que otra carencia, sobretodo en lo que se refiere a su elevada dificultad. En general será bastante más completo en modos de juego, y evolucionado tanto a nivel sonoro como gráfico.    Como ya hiciera la segunda entrega, los personajes a elegiur provienen de las cartas del Tarot, aunque en esta ocasión vendrán las 22 cartas y no sólo una selección: World (el Mundo), Fool (el Loco), Magician (el Mago), High Priestess (la Sacerdotisa), Empress (la Emperatriz), Emperor (el Emperador), Hierophant (el Sumo Sacerdote)... Todos los personajes han sido diseñados con un estilo que se acerca al manga, pero que coge igualmente tintes cartoon, incluso un aire marcadamente cómico.

meta.name: Mahjong Yarouze!

Mahjong is a game for four players that originated in China. It was called, meaning sparrow in ancient China, which is still the name most commonly used in some southern Chinese dialects such as Cantonese and Minnan, as well as in Japanese. However, most Mandarin-speaking Chinese now call the game m? ji?ng.
 Mahjong involves skill, strategy, and calculation, as well as a certain degree of luck (depending on the variation played, luck can be anything from a minor to a dominant factor in winning). In Asia, mahjong is also popularly played as a gambling game. In the game, each player is dealt either thirteen or sixteen tiles in a hand, depending on the variation being played. On their turn, players draw a tile and discard one, with the goal of making four or five melds (also depending on the variation) and one pair, or "head". Winning comes "on the draw" by drawing a new or discarded tile that completes the hand. Thus, a winning hand actually contains fourteen (or seventeen) tiles.
 Mahjong Yarouze! is a mahjong game with cartoon graphics in which the player controls a mahjong player that will play mahjong in different leagues.
 The game uses a first person perspective and the gameplay is play mahjong againts 3 opponents.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 188.75 MB

Aunque está clasificado como un “action RPG”, para ser sinceros, eso no es del todo preciso. El enfoque del juego parece estar en aprender (y crear) magia en un estilo de simulación con pantallas estáticas, lo que recuerda a la serie Atelier de Gust o incluso a Princess Maker.
Para lograrlo, debes desplazarte por diferentes lugares; es ahí donde controlas a tu personaje en un entorno 3D similar al mundo de Grandia. Es en esos espacios donde se producen los encuentros con enemigos y donde encuentras objetos e ingredientes. Por ello, el juego es bastante denso en texto. No es el típico RPG, y los menús están completamente en kanji.
El juego presenta una perspectiva en primera persona en 2D durante la parte de la historia, y una perspectiva en tercera persona con personajes 2D en secciones donde la cámara se puede acercar, alejar y rotar 360 grados.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 151.22 MB

The cat (Felis catus), also known as the domestic cat or housecat to distinguish it from other felines and felids, is a small domesticated carnivorous mammal that is valued by humans for its companionship and its ability to hunt vermin and household pests. Cats have been associated with humans for at least 9,500 years,[6] and are currently the most popular pet in the world.
 Due to their close association with humans, cats are now found almost everywhere on Earth. Their adaptability, rapid breeding rate, and predatory instincts make them effective hunters. In some locations, cats have affected indigenous animal populations; this has led them to be classified as an invasive species in some areas. Most problems are caused by the large number of feral cats worldwide, with a population of up to 60 million of these animals in the United States alone. Failure to control the breeding of pet cats by spaying and neutering and the abandonment of former household pets cause the development of such feral colonies.
 Mainichi Neko Youbi is a simulation game you can choose from ten differents cat's breeds, you can see it grow and if you have a couple of cats you can even have kittens. The player can buy the cat toys, different meals, fishes or milk, etc. The player can wash the cat, take it to the veterinarian or even to a Cat contest.
 The game features a complete encyclopedia in japanese about the different cat breeds.

Makeruna! Makendo fue un videojuego para Super Nintendo Entertainment System de Datam Polystar. Seta U.S.A. creó la versión en inglés. La versión japonesa original del juego está protagonizada por una chica llamada Mai Tsurugino. Un detective espiritual llamado Doro encuentra a Mai y le pide que lo ayude a atacar a los monstruos. Makeruna Makendo 2, el segundo de la serie, es una conversión del favorito de Super Famicom con chicas de anime en un campo de lucha en 2D y supermovimientos superfluos. Algunos de los mejores escenarios también con escenarios de ballet, estadios de fútbol y la bulliciosa noche del centro de Osaka. El Primer Ministro Fantasma está organizando un torneo de lucha, y Hikari Tsurugino, de 14 años, el segundo Mighty Makendo, debe enfrentarse a todo tipo de extrañas apariciones. Aparecen personajes del primer juego, incluidos Mai Tsurugino, la hermana de Hikari y el primer Mighty Makendo. Makeruna! Makendo 2 es un cómico juego de lucha VS con un elenco ecléctico de personajes que incluye un jugador de fútbol, ​​un zombi, un tritón musculoso y un robot gigante. Los combates son mejores dos de tres, y cada personaje tiene una barra de vida y un medidor "Makendo", que le permite a cada personaje realizar una variedad de ataques especiales. El juego incluye un modo historia y un modo versus para 2 jugadores. Hay ocho caracteres seleccionables.

 The game begins when a young girl is walking in a street and she see how another girl dies of spontaneous combustion, she call the police and ambulance. A diferencia de otros juegos de gestión futbolística para consola de la época, que eran adaptaciones de títulos existentes para PC, LMA Manager se diseñó exclusivamente para PlayStation. El juego destaca por su intuitivo sistema de control, en el que los botones de hombro L1 y R1 del mando cambian entre las distintas secciones del juego (por ejemplo, de la sección Traspasos a la sección Plantilla), y L2 y R2 cambian entre las subpantallas de una sección (por ejemplo, de la pantalla Selección de equipo a Edición de tácticas). Como simulador de gestión completo, los jugadores pueden empezar un partido abierto o enfrentarse a uno de los diez desafíos.

Sven-Göran Eriksson Born 5 February 1948) in Sweden commonly referred to just by his nickname Svennis, is a Swedish football manager, currently managing Football League Championship side Leicester City
He has won 17 major trophies as a manager, with a variety of clubs, between 1979 and 2000, when he became the first manager to win league-and-cup doubles in three different countries. He later managed the national teams of England, Mexico and Côte d'Ivoire.
Sven-Göran Eriksson's World Challenge is a soccer game. It features 204 national teams from all over the world. There are six playing modes: Exhibition match, training, league, play-offs, World Cup qualification or World Cup championship. It uses the same handling as the Kick Off series, which means the ball doesn't stick to the players' feet. There are just three buttons to use: shooting, passing and tackling. The whole technical side of the game is the same as in Kick Off 2002.

meta.name: NCAA March Madness '98
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 286.78 MB

EA Sports finally hits the college basketball scene with NCAA March Madness '98 for the PlayStation. Along with a full NCAA license is 107 Division I teams, team-specific fight songs and chants as well as authentic college uniforms and logos. Nine women's teams have also been included, which is a first for a college sports game (or any sports game for that matter). Also unique to this game is the Momentum Meter, which will rise as your team starts to get hot. Once it's maxed, look out -- the crowd will become frenzied and your shooting percentage increases.
 You'll also have the ability to create your very own players, modify rosters, call plays on the fly and use the give-and-go to outmaneuver your opponent. You can also make substitutions for tired or fouled-out players and check their statistics during the game.
 While taking your team through an entire 1997-98 season with a schedule of thirty games, make sure you call the right offensive and defensive formations if you want a shot at winning them. The Exhibition mode is the way to go for single match-ups and practicing control setups. If you're feeling game, take on the Tourney mode -- a 64 team NCAA Championship Tournament! Bring home the glory to your alma mater!

In Maria Kimitachi ga Umareta Wake, you play as a young psychiatrist named Takano. One day a new patient is brought into the hospital you work in - Maria, a young woman who has attempted suicide. She suffers from amnesia, and you try to find out more about her, visiting her and talking to her. Before long you discover that Maria has schizophrenia - a split personality. Her "other self" appears to be evil and threatens to take over her. The fight for Maria's sanity begins.
 The game plays like an interactive novel or movie: you read text and from time to time make a choice from two or more available ones. Instead of the standard 2D anim?-style graphics the game utilizes semi-realistic CG pre-rendered backgrounds and characters. There are also CG animated movies in the game.

Marlone is a student at the Royal School of Sorcery (known simply as "The Academy") in the city of Salberg. She's studying to become an alchemist, but her grades are, to put it lightly, not good. Unable to graduate, she is given a special exam: continue her studies while running a shop, and learn to create a high-level item within five years. And so, Marlone is now running the shop, attempting to pass her exam in order to graduate.Atelier Marie is the first title in the long-running alchemy RPG series from Gust, and establishes many of the features common to the series. Central to the game is researching different items, locating them, and fusing them to create (hopefully) more powerful ones. You can also explore the city and outside, looking for items and training your characters' fighting abilities in battle. All the while, those five years are slowly ticking away, so you'd better make the most of them.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 434.20 MB

Martial Beat was a game created by Konami for the arcade and PlayStation in Japan in 2002. This game tests skill in martial arts, and it is not really considered part of Konami's Bemani series, even though it contains music from the series. This game was shipped in a modified Dance Dance Revolution cabinet, with the sensors and the game's art on it. Even though there is the presence of two sets of selection buttons (as Dance Dance Revolution supported two players), this game is one player only. To play the game, one needs to follow the on-screen instructor, and when a red light turns on located on top of the screen, the player must perform the move by repeating the instructor.
 The specialized controller consists of a base station, which is plugged into the playstation, and four sensors, one for each hand and foot.

 Martial Beat 2 is the sequel to one of the newest form of dance simuation games. This game actually helps you keep fit by mixing martial arts and music together! You punk and kick to the beat of music! It is a 3 piece controller; controller is strapped to your hands, ankles, and a sensor piece that senses when you punch and kick.
 Players can practice or move on to fitness and attack exercises. The game features real life instructors that will prompt the player to perform tasks.
 The game features different game modes like arcade mode, practice mode or fitness mode.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 293.94 MB

Marvel Super Heroes es un juego de lucha en 2D y el segundo título de Capcom que presenta personajes del universo cómico de Marvel. El juego es muy similar a X-Men: Hijos del átomo, pero con un indicador Super Combo simplificado y la adición de gemas infinitas. Cada personaje comienza con un conjunto de gemas. Estos se pueden activar durante una pelea para mejorar la velocidad, el poder y la defensa, o proporcionar habilidades especiales para crear muros de piedra aplastantes, abrir una grieta en el espacio o revertir los controles del oponente. El uso de las gemas está inspirado en la serie de cómics El guante infinito.

Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter es un juego de lucha en 2D y el primero en combinar personajes de la serie Street Fighter de Capcom con los del universo cómico de Marvel. También es el primero en los juegos de Capcom en introducir un estilo de combate de equipo donde el jugador puede llamar a otro personaje durante una pelea.
Las peleas son de dos contra dos en las que el jugador solo puede controlar un personaje a la vez. El otro personaje puede ser llamado regularmente o mientras está haciendo un ataque. El que está afuera de la pantalla también recupera salud mientras espera. Ambos personajes opuestos deben ser derrotados para ganar la partida, y cuando uno muere, el otro es llamado automáticamente.

Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter es un juego de lucha en 2D y el primero en combinar personajes de la serie Street Fighter de Capcom con los del universo cómico de Marvel. También es el primero en los juegos de Capcom en introducir un estilo de combate de equipo donde el jugador puede llamar a otro personaje durante una pelea.
Las peleas son de dos contra dos en las que el jugador solo puede controlar un personaje a la vez. El otro personaje puede ser llamado regularmente o mientras está haciendo un ataque. El que está afuera de la pantalla también recupera salud mientras espera. Ambos personajes opuestos deben ser derrotados para ganar la partida, y cuando uno muere, el otro es llamado automáticamente.

Mary King's Riding Star is a managerial simulation set in the equestrian sports business. The game focuses in the athletic part, this means there are no finances to manage and the goal of the game is to win as many championships as possible in the events dressage, cross country and showjumping. To achieve this goal the player has to "manage" his horse by using the training grounds to improve the horses's skills. The player also has to manually clean the stall and feed and groom the horse. The championships are shown in a isometric perspective with spoken commentary. There are options to personalize the game, e.g. by naming the horse and choose its color.The game is largely based on the original 1998 Riding Star and was created in cooperation with its developer Blue Tongue.

The Masters Tournament, also known as The Masters, or The U.S. Masters outside of the United States, is one of the four major championships in professional golf. Scheduled for the first full week of April, it is the first of the majors to be played each year. Unlike the other major championships, the Masters is held each year at the same location, Augusta National Golf Club, a private golf club in the city of Augusta, Georgia, USA. The Masters was started by Clifford Roberts and Bobby Jones, who designed Augusta National with course architect Alister MacKenzie. The tournament is an official money event on the PGA Tour, the PGA European Tour, and the Japan Golf Tour. The field of players is smaller than those of the other major championships because it is an invitational event, entry being controlled by the Augusta National Golf Club.

Hiroki Matsukata is a Japanese actor. He is the son jidaigeki actor Jushiro Konoe and actress Yaeko Mizukawa and has younger brother, actor Yuki Meguro.
 As a young man, he aspired to be a singer, but turned to acting, making his debut at age 17. He worked for Toei, specializing in jidaigeki and yakuza films. In 1969 he switched to Daiei as a replacement for Ichikawa Raizo VIII, starring in many films. On returning to Toei, he played in supporting roles, including Sakai Kin'ya in the Battles Without Honor and Humanity, starring Bunta Sugawara. With ex-wife actress Akiko Nishina he has two children. Son Masaki Nishina and daughter Hitomi Nishina are both in the entertainment industry.
 Hiroki Matsukata Presents - World Fishing is a fishing game endorsed by the popular actor that features 2 main game modes:
 - Billfish: That allows the player to take a boat and fish in the ocean.
 - Blackbass: That allows the player to take a boat and fish in a river.
 Each modes got a tutorial, a free fishing mode and a tournament mode, and the player can check the records of the fishes that he catched.

Cada misión tiene lugar en lugares completamente distintos y se divide en tres fases. Después de cada fase, tú y tu compañero recibís una puntuación en función de la precisión, el número de muertes, el número de rachas (impactos consecutivos), el número total de disparos efectuados, la cantidad de daño causado y vuestra puntuación total. La tercera misión sólo puede jugarse una vez completadas las dos primeras.
En los juegos de disparos estándar, debes intentar matar a los terroristas y salvar a los inocentes. Hay potenciadores para disparar que aumentan tu potencia de fuego hasta el nivel de una escopeta o una ametralladora.

meta.name: Medal of Honor : Résistance
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 468.83 MB

Medal of Honor: Underground es un videojuego de disparos en primera persona desarrollado por DreamWorks y distribuido por Electronic Arts. Fue lanzado para las consolas PlayStation y Game Boy Advance en 2000. Es el segundo videojuego de la serie Medal of Honor. Es un pre-cuela de su antecesor.
MOH: Underground tiene lugar antes de la campaña del MOH original y penetra más aún en la historia cuando se coloca en la piel de Manon Baptiste, una mujer miembro de la Resistencia Francesa en contra de la ocupación Nazi. Durante el juego, Manon debe realizar diferentes misiones que la llevan por toda Europa y Norte de África para intentar detener a la Wehrmacht.

meta.name: Medarot R
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 73.00 MB

Medabots (también conocido como Medarot) fue originalmente un videojuego RPG desarrollado por Imagineer y publicado por Natsume en 1997. El juego fue adaptado más tarde a una serie de televisión de anime japonesa producida por Bee Train. Medarot R es el remake de Playstation One del clásico juego de Gameboy y es el primer juego de Medarot que se lanzó con gráficos en 3D para la consola Sony PlayStation. 
El modo de juego consiste en recorrer la ciudad conociendo a diferentes personajes y ganar las batallas para mejorar tu Medarot y avanzar en el juego.

meta.name: Medarot R : Parts Collection
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 63.24 MB

Medabots (también conocido como Medarot) fue originalmente un videojuego de Imagineer lanzado en 1997. Más tarde, el juego fue adaptado a una serie de anime para televisión japonesa producida por Bee Train. Con un total de 52 episodios, la serie se emitió originalmente en TV Tokyo desde el 2 de julio de 1999 hasta el 30 de junio de 2000.
Medarot Damashii, una secuela de treinta y nueve episodios producida por Production I.G, se emitió del 7 de julio de 2000 al 30 de marzo de 2001.
Tanto la serie original como su secuela fueron licenciadas por Nelvana. La versión doblada al inglés por Nelvana de Medabots se emitió en Fox Kids desde el 1 de septiembre de 2001 hasta el 2 de noviembre de 2002, convirtiéndose en una de las series nuevas con mayor audiencia del canal en ese periodo. Medarot Damashii llegó un año después, emitiéndose del 13 de septiembre de 2003 al 7 de marzo de 2004.

meta.name: MediEvil
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 271.09 MB

En el reino de Gallowmere, año 1286, el poderoso mago Zarok, desterrado por nigromancia, reunió a un numeroso ejército de zombis, demonios y otros monstruos con la intención de conquistar el reino al que pertenecía y vengarse de la familia real. Tras una breve sucesión de escaramuzas, los mejores soldados tanto del ejército del Rey Peregrino como los del de Zarok se enfrentaron en una batalla final en la que el capitán del Rey Peregrino, Sir Daniel Fortesque, se enfrentó en duelo singular combate a Zarok, acabando con su vida antes de sucumbir ante sus propias heridas mortales. La batalla, sin la magia de Zarok para mantener a las huestes malignas, fue ganada por el ejército real.

La trama comienza cuando el héroe robótico Mega Man es llamado para investigar una misteriosa lectura de energía proveniente del reciente choque de un meteorito contra una isla. Mega Man descubre que su archienemigo, el Dr. Wily, se le adelantó e inmediatamente se retiró con la fuente de energía. A Mega Man se le encomienda detener los malvados planes del Dr. Wily para usar esa energía, así como descubrir el propósito de un misterioso robot alíen encontrado en el lugar del impacto. Junto con nuevos full motion videos animados y doblaje de voz, Mega Man 8 presenta gráficos y sonido mejorados con respecto a las anteriores entregas de la serie. La historia comienza espués de haber explorado la isla de Kattelox y haberla rescatado de los Bones, Megaman, Roll y el Profesor Barrell se toman un periodo de descanso.
Entre tanto el profesor viaja con un viejo amigo de sus épocas de Digger Von Bluecher quien utilizando toda su fortuna construye una nave llamada Sulphur Bottom para intentar aterrizar en el lugar donde se encuentra el tesoro de Mother Lode que está obstruido por una tormenta al parecer perpetua en el extremo polar del mundo.
El profesor y su amigo Von lo habían intentado hace 30 años pero ambos se estrellaron y perdieron la memoria , pero antes de perder la memoria , vieron a una misteriosa muchacha , la leyenda cuenta que todos los que han sobrevivido en su intento de entrar al Mother Lode han visto a esta muchacha.
Mientras tanto Tron, Tiesel y compañía se encuentran espiando la operación que de por si ya es cubierta por la prensa generando gran expectativa, minutos antes de empezar, una misteriosa chica aparece y les da una advertencia acerca del peligro que implica abrir el tesoro, y se va entre un gran ajetreo.

Mega Man X3 tiene lugar en un futuro ficticio en el que el mundo está poblado por humanos y robots inteligentes llamados "Reploids". Al igual que sus creadores humanos, algunos Reploids se involucran en delitos destructivos, diciéndose de ellos que se han vuelto "Maverick" (rebeldes). Tras dos derrotas del líder Maverick Sigma, los protagonistas, los "Maverick Hunters" (Cazadores de Mavericks) Mega Man X y Zero se enfrentan a un nuevo enemigo: un científico Reploid llamado Dr. Doppler.

meta.name: Mega Man X4
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 366.73 MB

lgún tiempo después de la Dopplertown de crisis, Caín laboratorios recibe el mandato de desarrollar una fuerza militar complementarias Hunters Mavericks. Esta fuerza armada en su totalidad de reploides, nacido bajo el nombre de "Repliforce".
Sin embargo, sólo seis meses después de asumir el cargo, el Repliforce se considera ineficaz y potencialmente peligroso. La situación se vuelve explosivo cuando un gran ataque causa de la caída de Sky Lagoon, una ciudad flotante vasto, matando a cientos y hasta miles de seres humanos y Reploids. Acusado de orquestar la tragedia, la respuesta Repliforce declarar inmediatamente su independencia, incluso recurriendo a la fuerza de las armas.
La sede de los Cazadores, la situación es grave. Para evitar una guerra importante, X y Zero son enviados a hacer huelgas estratégicas contra el grupo rebelde

Megaman vuelve a PSOne con la sexta parte de su saga Megaman X la cual se desarrolla en el futuro. En esta sexta entrega el argumento parte nada más acabar Megaman X5 en el que Zero se sacrificaba para acabar con el malvado Reploid. Dos semanas mas tarde la Tierra sería una zona en ruinas después de que el virus de Maverik causara estragos. Ahora, un científico llamado Issac intenta demostrar que Zero era el portador original. 8 Reploids son enviados a la zona en ruinas, y todos son infectados.
Ahora es el turno de nuestro querido Megaman (en esta saga de juegos lo llaman X) para detener a esta nueva oleada de Maveriks, y para averiguar qué le ocurrió a su amigo Zero.

In this unique RPG from Xing Entertainment, you take on the role of a mermaid attemping to discover the secrets of her race.
 Based on an anime series from the mid-90s, the plot goes something like this: ages ago the goddess Aphrodite created the world, but the jealous Merdam, also known as the Destroyer, contested her control. After a great battle, the Destroyer was locked away forever, and the denizens of Meremanoia flourished, building a civilization in their Creatrice's image - peaceful, compassionate, and very female. This is how the Church and the royal family choose to interpret things, at least. What the priestly Mer-Lion caste doesn't like to talk about is the sacred text that foretells the coming of a new Destroyer, one who looks like a Meremanoid but is not. Words cannot describe this being - but only because the language of the mermaids contains no masculine adjectives. In other words, the Y chromosome is believed to be the Harbinger of the Apocalypse.

Mermaid no Kisetsu es un puerto de PlayStation de la novela visual hentai con contenido para adultos. El juego sigue a Masato Takahata, un estudiante de segundo año de secundaria, que vive solo, va a clases y trabaja medio tiempo en el café Aqua Rouge. El escenario está en el futuro cercano con avances tecnológicos, pero el estilo de vida no cambió mucho. Un día encuentras una nota extraña con la dirección de una página. Lo revisas solo para ver el siniestro texto de advertencia. Si bien no estás tratando de descubrir el misterio detrás de esto, recorrerás la ciudad conociendo a varias personas, en su mayoría chicas y mujeres, con las que trabajarás en una relación para hacerte amigo, o algo más.

Mermaid no Kisetsu Curtain Call can be considered as fan disc release for the users that get the original game Mermaid no Kisetsu. In this game the player can see a lot of different game modes, original CG galleries and other things:
 - Conversational mode: Is some kind of communication mode with the game main characters. The volume of the conversation can be adjusted.
 - Scenario mode: All the main story wasn't told in the first game, here the player can see 13 different scenerarios with different side characters and the 4 main ones.
 - Prelude mode: See what happened before teh first game started.
 - Quiz mode: More than 900 different questions about the first game.
 - CG Mode: A collection of different pictures and original illustrations.
 - Drama voice: 8 voices recorded.
 - DJ Corner: Listen to the radio program and the DJ
 There are also these 5 galleries: "Original drawing room", "Official Graphics", "4 frame mode" privacy with sound production, "character set" & "movie"

Merriment Carrying Caravan tells the story of a 42 years settler (Dickens Ford) that travels through a colonial planet called Grant with his 4 daughters, the game takes place during a whole year and the player got to earn money and make the life of the girls happier.
 The caravan compete against other families: Butler (company Wing Over), Miller, Nelson, King & High Net Transport.
 There are different trade routes to travel and trade. The gameplay is an strategy adventure that places your party in the task of establishing trade routes, managing resources and exploring new cities, etc.
 The game features japanese voice acting for the main characters.

Metal Angel 3 is the sequel released only in Playstation to the 2 games released in the PC Engine console.
 The game takes place in the year 2038 and the player will take the role of the manager of a female team that was defeated on the last year championship of a futuristic sport that is about defeat the other team members using some kind of mechanical armors. The gameplay is about decide which training the team members will do each week and talk to them about their training and other subjects to improve their stats.
 Depending of the player decisions the team members stats will increase or decrease in different things, and there will be also a different number of points to upgrade the armors. The player can also decide the tactics and other things about the game. The trainings can be about swimming in the pool, repairing the armors, running, gymnastic, etc.
 The game uses a first person perspective for the conversations with the team members and a third one to move around the place. The game features japanese voice acting for the female characters.

Fighting Force es un videojuego en 3D del género beat 'em up, lanzado en 1997, desarrollado por Core Design y publicado por Eidos. Metal Slug: Super Vehicle-001 es un videojuego run and gun para la consola Neo-Geo y la plataforma arcade desarrollado por Nazca y publicado por SNK. Se lanzó originalmente en 1996 para la plataforma arcade MVS. El juego es muy conocido por su sentido del humor, su fluida animación dibujada a mano y su trepidante acción para dos jugadores. Based on the award-winning book by David Kirk, Miss Spider's Tea Party offers young children eight games that encourage cognitive thinking skills. 			Skill levels of easy, medium, and hard can be chosen to suit age appropriateness and the variety of games include Firefly Concentration, Find the Butterflies, Grampy Spider's Picture Perfect, Assemble the Cricket Band, Caterpillar and Moth Obstacle Course, Beetle's River Crossing, Mr. Ant's Maze, and the Bee Game. The activities in each game are essentially matching and memorization oriented with the exception of Find the Butterflies in which the object is to find butterflies hidden within different scenes. 			Miss Spider and the other characters exchange rhyming dialogue and then give instructions for each game. The invitations are accepted when all eight games are finished. The game ends as credits roll over footage of Miss Spider's tea party with all her friends in attendance as she extends one last invitation to the child to play again.

This baseball game is an update to MLB 2000. The game contains depictions of the real teams, stadiums, stats, and players that reflect their real life counterparts. This game features Exhibition, All-Star Game, Season, Playoffs, Spring Training, and Home Run Derby modes. There is also a Franchise mode that let's the player build a team from scratch and try to turn it into a World Series caliber team. Another feature the game has is Manager mode which lets the player  check out scouting reports during the game, warm up relievers in the bullpen, and try to get their team to the World Series and hopefully win it.
A unique feature of this game is the Total Control Fielding and Total Control Batting systems. The batting system effects how much control the player has on how the ball is hit, which direction it gets hit to, and the power of the batter's swing.The fielding system lets the player have more control over the fielders. There is also an Advanced Batting Cursor option where guessing the pitcher's pitch correctly let's the player lock on to the pitch for more power while guessing incorrectly will make the batting cursor shrink and make the ball harder to hit
The Artificial Intelligence used in the game was developed with consultation from Tony Gwynn, Trevor Hoffman and Davey Johnson. Vin Scully and Dave Campbell are on hand to supply commentary during the game.

Momotaro Densetsu is a role-playing video game series in Japan featuring the character Momotaro from Japanese folklore, as well as other Japanese folklore characters such as Kintaro, Urashima Taro, and Princess Kaguya of The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter.
 Started in 1987, the series is produced by Hudson Soft. The title is sometimes confused with that of Momotaro Dentetsu, another video game series by Hudson Soft. As with Momotaro Dentetsu, the project supervisor for the Momotaro Densetsu series is Akira Sakuma, with illustration by Takayuki Doi and main music production by Kazuyuki Sekiguchi of Southern All Stars.
 The Momotarou Densetsu games are based on a fairy tale that is about a boy that is born from a peach and is raised by an old couple. The game series begun in NES, X68000 and PC Engine with versions in SNES and Playstation.
 Momotarou Densetsu is the first game for the Playstation console and features the classic RPG 2d gameplay with cartoon characters and with a first person perspective in the battles. The enemies are usually animals and devils.

Money Idol Exchanger (also known as Money Puzzle Exchanger in the US) is a puzzle game created in 1997 by Japanese video game developer Face for the Neo-Geo MVS arcade system. Athena Co. Ltd. ported it to the Game Boy and the PlayStation that same year.
 Money Idol Exchanger is a stacking game similar to the Magical Drop, Astro Pop, Moujya and Puzzle Bobble series whereby players race to prevent a perpetually falling array of coins in different values from filling up the screen. Coins are combined (vertically and/or horizontally) to form higher valued coins; for example, five '1' coins will form a '5' coin, and two '5' coins will form a '10' coin, and so on, until two '500' coins are put together, at which point both disappear. Coins are arranged and colored to match denominations of the yen specie. Two bonus tiles allow for changes in gameplay.

In this game you play a monkey, a brave little monkey, who has been trained by another monkey called Master Sage. When the game begins, three worlds are fighting against each other. The Dream World, The Nightmare World and The Waking World. The Nightmare King has stolen a book, The Magic Story Book, which is keeping the peace in the three worlds. You have to get it back. Make your way through the Waking World while fighting The Nightmare King's minions to get the book back. Travel through libraries, forests and mines.  
Make friends which will help you on your quest. Use your weapons to crush crates; these crates often contain fruits which increases your health. (If you don't have a weapon to crush the crates with, then you have to throw them) You will acquire two weapons throughout the game: A bamboo stick to hit your enemies with and small rockets or spears to shoot down enemies far away from you. Solve many puzzles, defeat bosses and explore the huge world of "Monkey Hero".

meta.name: Monopoly
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 231.02 MB

The game of Monopoly has been around ever since the Great Depression-era of the 1920s. The PlayStation version of the game boasts token and property animations, rule variations, real-time board rotation and multi-player link options.
 The premise of the game is the same as it has always been. You have to purchase as much property as possible and then build it up in hopes of bankrupting your opponents and remaining as the only entrepreneur left. You are given $1,500 in cash to start with and must try to build up from there. Purchase properties ranging from Boardwalk to Water Works, put houses on them, and watch your money grow.
 You can play with up to seven other human or computer opponents who will all be aiming for you and your property. You can make deals with your opponents since trades and immunities are available. Just watch out though, because they may try to stab you behind your back.
 If you are in a long, tension-filled game that you need to get out of, you can save the game to an open block on your memory card. The game also supports a mouse as well as the Multi Tap device.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 132.73 MB

In Monsterseed, players assume the role of Daniel, a young "ruler" who begins the game by getting himself beaten unconscious, but is rescued by the lovely Kal and her rugged grandfather, Wolf. Daniel learns that the thugs who attacked him are part of an evil gang terrorizing his benefactors' little town. The gang's leader Murdoch is collecting ancient statues to open a gateway to the Dark World, hoping to resurrect an immensely powerful monster. Driven by a sense of duty to repay and protect Wolf and Kal, Daniel pursues Murdoch through labyrinthine mines and ruins, a booby-trapped mansion, and even through the Dark World itself, fighting wild monsters and collecting monster seeds along the way.
 At first Daniel buys his monsters at the town hatchery, but as the game progresses, he obtains increasingly potent seeds to hatch on his own. By adjusting hatching temperatures, different monsters can be produced from each seed. Daniel can also add solutions to a seed during hatching to boost certain characteristics of his monsters.
 Monsters have several characteristics affecting their behavior. For example, willpower indicates how determined a monster is in battle; an "unforgiving" monster is quick to enter battle, while a "cowardly" one may ignore Daniel's commands or even beg to be recalled. Response time indicates how quickly a monster will materialize after being summoned; a "quite slow" monster may not materialize for several rounds after Daniel has summoned it, but a "quite fast" monster responds immediately.

meta.name: Morita Kazuo No Reversi
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 9.08 MB

Reversi (also marketed by Pressman under the trade name Othello) is a board game involving abstract strategy and played by two players on a board with 8 rows and 8 columns and a set of distinct pieces for each side. Pieces typically are disks with a light and a dark face, each side belonging to one player. The player's goal is to have a majority of their colored pieces showing at the end of the game, turning over as many of their opponent's pieces as possible.
 Rules:
 Each of the two sides corresponds to one player; they are referred to here as light and dark after the sides of Othello pieces, but "heads" and "tails" would identify them equally well, so long as each marker has sufficiently distinctive sides.
 Originally, Reversi did not have a defined starting position. Later it adopted Othello's rules, which state that the game begins with four markers placed in a square in the middle of the grid, two facing light-up, two pieces with the dark side up. The dark player makes the first move.
 Simple 1500 Series vol.004 - Reversi is a reversi game that features 3 different boards and backgrounds, and also a 2 players vs mode

meta.name: Morita Kazuro No Shougi Doujou
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 20.01 MB

El shogi, también conocido como ajedrez japonés, es un juego de mesa para dos jugadores de la misma familia que el ajedrez occidental, el chaturanga y el Xiangqi chino, y es el más popular de una familia de variantes de ajedrez propias de Japón. Shogi significa “el del general”.
El predecesor más antiguo del juego, el chaturanga, se originó en la India en el siglo VI y se difundió desde China hasta Japón, donde dio lugar a varias variantes. El shogi en su forma actual ya se jugaba en el siglo XVI, mientras que un ancestro directo sin la “regla de las piezas capturadas” se registró en 1210 en un documento histórico llamado Nichureki, que es una copia editada de Shochureki y Kaichureki del periodo Heian tardío (aprox. 1120).

Mortal Kombat II e similar a su antecesor, pero presenta una serie de mejoras, como una mejora gráfica, mejores efectos de sonido, un juego más rápido (y más difícil), una animación más fluida y más personajes (incluido un Shang Tsung jugable).
Naturalmente, el juego es violento e incluye además del conocido Fatality, se agregaron "Babalities" y "Friendships" para apaciguar (en realidad, burlarse de) los grupos de ciudadanos preocupados por el alto nivel de sangre y gore de la serie. Estos movimientos un poco más amables y suaves incluyen cosas como convertir a tu oponente en un bebé y darle un ramo de flores.

meta.name: Mortal Kombat Mythologies : Sub-Zero
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 307.32 MB

Midway decidió hacer algo un poco diferente con su franquicia de Mortal Kombat. Decidieron que en lugar de hacer un juego MK completamente nuevo, harían un juego que se centrara en un personaje en particular de la popular serie; un mini MK si se quiere. Iluminarían a los jugadores del pasado y del presente con una historia, en lugar de peleas sin sentido para ganar un torneo. El personaje elegido es Sub Zero, y el juego se llama acertadamente Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub Zero.
Mythologies sigue siendo fiel a su serie madre (hasta Mortal Kombat 4, de todos modos) en algunos aspectos: todos los personajes están digitalizados y el juego sigue siendo 2D. Pero a diferencia de los otros juegos de la serie, éste es una aventura de plataformas. No sólo luchas por ganar un torneo, sino por descubrir toda la historia de Sub Zero. Claro que seguirás golpeando a muchos malos, pero el juego es básicamente un juego de "salto de plataforma a plataforma". A mitad de camino incluso se añaden algunos elementos de RPG, como la colección de objetos y una pantalla de menú, para darle un poco de sabor a las cosas.

meta.name: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 295.81 MB

El segundo juego de Mortal Kombat en PlayStation combina personajes, etapas y movimientos de entregas anteriores en la violenta serie de combates. Elige entre un total de 36 personajes jugables, incluidas las versiones alternativas de Kano, Jax, Raiden, Sub-Zero y Kung Lao. Al igual que en juegos anteriores, debes luchar y vencer a cada oponente en sucesión en tu misión para enfrentarte al malvado Shao Khan. Cada combate es al mejor de tres que implica agotar la salud de un rival, en cuyo punto puedes iniciar un movimiento de "calidad" específico del personaje: Fatality, Animality, Babality o Brutality.
Una de las nuevas características clave en Mortal Kombat Trilogy es el "Modo Aggressor Kombat". Los combos de aterrizaje llenan un medidor horizontal que, cuando está al máximo, permite a los personajes desatar ataques aún más poderosos. Además del modo arcade para un solo jugador, los jugadores pueden desafiar a un amigo en una pelea uno contra uno, una batalla de dos contra dos o participar en un torneo round-robin que abarca ocho combatientes. La derrota de Shao Khan tiene el beneficio adicional de desbloquear hasta 12 cajas del tesoro, con sorpresas que van desde un minijuego de Galaga hasta demostraciones en video de las muertes del título.

This is a Playstation game based on the story of Moses (Moses was born in a time when his people, the Children of Israel, were increasing in number and the Egyptian Pharaoh was worried that they might help Egypt's enemies. Moses' Hebrew mother, Jochebed, hid him when the Pharaoh ordered all newborn Hebrew boys to be killed, and the child was adopted as a foundling by the Egyptian royal family. After killing an Egyptian slave-master, Moses fled across the Red Sea to Midian where he encountered the God of Israel in the form of a "burning bush". God sent Moses to request the release of the Israelites. After the Ten Plagues, Moses led the Exodus of the Israelites out of Egypt and across the Red Sea, after which they based themselves at Mount Sinai, where Moses received the Ten Commandments. After 40 years of wandering in the desert, Moses died within sight of the Promised Land).

 Cartoon film

meta.name: Motor Toon Grand Prix 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 250.61 MB

El Motor Toon Grand Prix original sólo salió a la venta en Japón, un juego de carreras creativo que nunca llegó a cuajar debido a su escasa jugabilidad. Motor Toon GP 2 es una imaginativa montaña rusa de dibujos animados ambientada en una serie de mundos estrafalarios con grandes similitudes entre una mezcla de Mario Kart y Wipeout. Motor Toon Grand Prix 2 de Sony lleva las carreras a un mundo furiosamente deformado de imágenes de dibujos animados y luces brillantes. Visualmente, el juego es espectacular y lleva a los jugadores por lugares como castillos encantados, carreteras de cristal, volcanes y otros escenarios de dibujos animados. Motor Toon GP2 cuenta con más de diez circuitos y ocho corredores, cada uno con habilidades y destrezas diferentes. A diferencia de muchos otros títulos de carácter simpático e infantil, Motor Toon GP2 no es apto para pusilánimes e incluye cinco niveles de dificultad. Motor Toon Grand Prix 2 también aprovecha la función de enlace de Sony y se incluye una copia del juego en un segundo disco.

Motorhead es un título de carreras futurista que presenta un total de diez vehículos en ocho circuitos sinuosos, que van desde un área industrial hasta un desierto. Cada vehículo se diferencia en velocidad, aceleración y agarre. No hay armas ni potenciadores; solo eres tú, un amigo o la computadora compitiendo por el tiempo más rápido. Los cuatro modos de juego incluyen Time Attack, League, Head-to-Head y Single Race. Cada modo ofrece la opción de ver la acción a 30 o 60 fotogramas por segundo (25 o 50 en versión PAL), siendo la diferencia clave la cantidad de autos controlados por computadora en la pista.
Características:
* Diez vehículos futuristas
* Ocho pistas temáticas
* Modo de dos jugadores a pantalla dividida

Mōri Motonari – Chikai no Sanshi Mōri (Mōri Motonari: Juramento de las Tres Flechas) es la tercera entrega de la serie Eiketsuden de Eiji Fukuzawa, una serie de juegos de simulación que retrata a las figuras históricas protagonistas bajo una imagen heroica. En el momento del lanzamiento del juego, se estaba emitiendo un drama Taiga de temática similar. Es el único título de la serie que no tiene múltiples finales.
El juego gira en torno a la vida y las conquistas de Motonari Mōri y de su nieto. En este título, el tiempo pasa en intervalos fijos y varios personajes envejecen visualmente a lo largo de la historia. Los jugadores pueden ver los nombres de infancia de varios daimyō y presenciar cómo crecen hasta la adultez. En el caso de Motonari, envejece desde niño hasta anciano y muere dentro de la narrativa. Tras su muerte, el jugador termina el juego con Terumoto. La historia sigue modestamente los acontecimientos históricos hasta que Terumoto asume el liderazgo del clan.

En Mr. Prospector Horiate-Kun, el jugador controla a un perro que debe excavar en diferentes minas para descubrir tesoros y otros objetos. El personaje sigue los pasos de su padre, ya que fue atacado cuando buscaba un tesoro escondido.
El juego presenta diferentes objetos (más de 250) y equipamiento para el personaje. La parte de excavación es similar a los antiguos juegos arcade como Boulder Dash o Mr. Do.
Hay 7 minas para explorar: "Mina 1G", "Mina 10G", "Mina 100G", "Mina 1000G", "Mina 10,000G", "Mina 100,000G" y "Mina 1,000,000G". Cada una de ellas se abrirá cuando el jugador explore completamente la anterior. Pero la parte difícil es que el juego cuenta con oxígeno: cuando el personaje está excavando, el oxígeno se reduce hasta llegar a 0. Cuando eso sucede, el jugador tendrá que jugar esa mina nuevamente.

meta.desc:

Ms. Pac-Man: Maze Madness es un juego de rompecabezas de acción con vista isométrica en 3D. Juegas como la Sra. Pac-Man y debes navegar por los laberintos mientras evitas a los monstruos. Cada vez que un monstruo te toca o golpea, parte de tu barra de salud se pierde, y si pierdes toda tu barra de salud, el juego termina. Si comes un punto de poder, serás invencible por un corto período de tiempo e incluso podrás comerte a los monstruos. El juego se compone de una serie de niveles temáticos, y cada nivel tiene cuatro estrellas doradas para coleccionar. Puedes conseguir una estrella dorada completando el nivel, comiendo todos los puntos del nivel, comiendo las siete frutas ocultas del nivel o completando la contrarreloj del nivel. Estas estrellas se pueden usar para desbloquear los secretos del juego. El juego de arcade original de Ms. Pac-Man también se incluye en el disco.

meta.name: MTV Sports : Pure Ride
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 268.79 MB

MTV Sports: Pure Ride is a multi-event snowboarding game that brings trick and stunt action, as well as high-speed downhill jaunts, to the PlayStation. The game contains a number of different snowboarding characters from around the world -- most of them are fictitious, and some are quite wacky in their design. -- and a variety of boards for snow shredding. Each rider and board has his or her (or its) own strengths and weaknesses.
			For those who aren't down with a bunch of silly rules, Free Ride mode allows players to hit the slopes free of score or trick requirements to simply enjoy the thrill of snowboarding. In Tour Challenge, an around-the-world jaunt, there are a number of different requirements for passing levels. There are five different tours to choose from and 12 different events to take on. Beating different levels will release them for use in Free Ride.
			If you're the type that eschews variety for specialization, then the Specialist mode is for you. In this mode, players can take on specific types of challenges, ranging from Big Air to Slopestyle to Half-pipe, shredding through 12 courses to unlock more levels. Stunt Mode rounds out the different ways to play Pure Ride, and in it players must complete 18 stages, hitting a variety of tricks to progress.
			There is also a two-player feature that allows multiple snowboarders to take each other on in a myriad of events. And if you enjoy making your own levels, prepare to rejoice, for Pure Ride allows you to construct your own slopes, making them as tame or insane as you like.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 280.28 MB

MTV Sports Skateboarding featuring Andy McDonald is the first game from the MTV Sports line, and like Tony Hawk's Pro Skater, it combines real elements of the sport with fantastic tricks and parks that would be impossible to recreate in real life.
			The game features a mix of real professional boarders and fantasy characters, and highlights venues from around the world. Every character has the same set of tricks, but they have different stats when it comes to attributes such as balance and jump height. The levels have a number of different goals for players to accomplish, but the only true way to pass a level is to rank high in a judging that takes place at the end of the run.
			Along with the standard bunch of tricks it brings to the table, MTV Sports Skateboarding features an extended system for flat land tricks, allowing for the possibility of even larger combos. There are a number of different game modes, including career, multiplayer and training modes, as well as a high score mode and an Icon Mode where you must find hidden MTV icons before time runs out. The soundtrack contains music from the likes of The Deftones, Cypress Hill, and Pennywise.

⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 322.93 MB

Muppet Monster Adventure es un juego de plataformas de acción.
La historia comienza con los Muppets que asisten a la lectura del testamento del tío  del Dr. Honeydew. En lugar de ir de vacaciones a un resort tropical, Robin y los demás se encuentran en un destartalado y espeluznante castillo. Al llegar Kermit, Miss Piggy, Fozzy y otros son capturados y ahora le toca al joven Robin (sobrino de Kermit) salvar el día.
Tienes que explorar todas las áreas y recoger gemas y fichas. Para obtener el 100% tiene que explorar cada esquina y averiguar cómo llegar a las plataformas de difícil acceso.
En los primeros niveles, Robin gana cuatro poderes especiales al recoger monedas Muppet especiales. Cuando se recogen todas las monedas de un grupo, Robin puede transformarse en diferentes tipos de monstruos en ciertos lugares. Aparecerá un icono en la esquina superior derecha, indicando que puede utilizar esta habilidad especial. Puede volar o flotar, escalar ciertas paredes, hacer un corte de karate para romper obstáculos, o ganar fuerza extra para empujar objetos.

Mushi no Idokoro is a puzzle game using insects in a fantasy world as the main character. The gameplay is about moving the different insect lines to get insects combinations and that will make them dissappear, the clear the level all the insects have to dissappear.
 The game features 3 game modes:
 1 - Ranking Mode: Compete against time
 2 - Story Mode: Advance through a story mode clearing the different puzzles.
 3 - Battle Mode: Play against another human player to clear the cube first.
 The game features also a Movie Mode in which the player can watch the movies that he unlocked in the story mode.
 Insects are a class within the arthropods that have a chitinous exoskeleton, a three-part body (head, thorax, and abdomen), three pairs of jointed legs, compound eyes, and two antennae. They are among the most diverse group of animals on the planet and include more than a million described species and represent more than half of all known living organisms. The number of extant species is estimated at between six and ten million, and potentially represent over 90% of the differing metazoan life forms on Earth. Insects may be found in nearly all environments, although only a small number of species occur in the oceans, a habitat dominated by another arthropod group, the crustaceans.

Eres una niña que es enviada a la casa de su abuela para ayudarla con su jardinería, ya que su edad hace que sea más difícil para ella atenderla. Interior design is a multifaceted profession that includes conceptual development, liaising with the stakeholders of a project and the management and execution of the design.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 343.61 MB

Acabas de toparte con un libro muy intrigante, un libro titulado Myst. No tienes idea de dónde vino, quién lo escribió o cuántos años tiene. Leer sus páginas le proporciona solo una descripción magníficamente elaborada de un mundo isleño. Pero es solo un libro, ¿no? Cuando llegas al final del libro, pones tu mano sobre una página. De repente, su propio mundo se disuelve en la oscuridad, reemplazado por el mundo de la isla que describen las páginas. Ahora estás aquí, donde sea que estés, sin otra opción que explorar.
Myst es una aventura de apuntar y hacer clic en primera persona donde el jugador controla un personaje conocido como The Stranger. Transportado mágicamente al mundo descrito en el libro, necesita explorar Myst Island y resolver sus misterios. El juego se presenta como una serie de escenas estáticas donde el jugador actúa con el entorno haciendo clic y manipulando objetos. No hay enemigos y no es posible morir. A través de Myst Island, el juego se divide en mini mundos ambientados en diferentes edades a los que se accede a través de diferentes libros.
La versión de PSP agrega nuevos escenarios de aventura e incluye soporte de pantalla panorámica.
La versión DS incluye una era completamente nueva, Rime Age y, junto a una reescritura de código, incluye nuevos efectos de sonido y videoclips remasterizados.

Many private rail companies rank among the top corporations in the country. Regional governments, and companies funded jointly by regional governments and private companies, also provide rail service.
 There are 27,268 km of rail crisscrossing the country. Japan's railways carried 22.24 billion passengers (395.9 billion passenger-kilometres) in fiscal 2006. In comparison, Germany has over 40,000 km of railways, but carries only 2.2 billion passengers per year.

Namco Namja Town is an indoor theme park in the Sunshine City shopping complex in east Ikebukuro, Toshima, Tokyo, Japan. The park was opened in 1996 by Namco, a Japanese company best known for producing video games, although the park itself does not focus on those games. Instead, it features themed dining, carnival-style games, a haunted house, and a line of character mascots exclusive to the park. It has 24 attractions inside of 6 towns, including ice cream town and gyoza town (Japanese dumplings), where you can enjoy famous restaurants from all over Japan.
 Located on the second and third floors of the World Import Mart Building in the Sunshine City complex, Namco Namja Town is one of the largest indoor theme parks in Japan, operated by Namco, a leading video arcade and amusement park company.

Miyuki Nakajima (born February 23, 1952, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan) is a Japanese singer-songwriter and radio personality. She has released 37 studio albums, 40 singles, 2 live albums and multiple compilations as of May 2013. Her sales have been estimated at more than 21 million copies.
 In the mid-1970s, Nakajima signed to Canyon Records and launched her recording career with her debut single, "Azami Jo no Rarabai". Rising to fame with the hit "The Parting Song (Wakareuta)", released in 1977, she has since seen a successful career as a singer-songwriter, primarily in the early 1980s. Four of her singles have sold more than one million copies in the last two decades, including "Earthly Stars (Unsung Heroes)", a theme song for the Japanese television documentary series Project X.
 Nakajima performed in experimental theater ("Yakai") every year-end from 1989 through 1998. The idiosyncratic acts featured scripts and songs she wrote, and have continued irregularly in recent years.
 In addition to her work as a solo artist, Nakajima has written over 90 compositions for numerous other singers, and has produced several chart-toppers. Many cover versions of her songs have been performed by Asian (particularly Taiwanese and Hong Kong) singers. She is the only musician to have participated in the National Language Council of Japan.
 Miyuki Nakajima - Namiromu is a digital database cd about the singer released for the Playstation console that features:
 - Discography: Browse through all Miyuki's discography with song samples.
 - History: You can browse here the videos, albums, singles, etc.
 - Video Clip: Watch any of the six avaliable videos.

Also known as J-League Prime Goal EX on Japan. It's one of the first football games in Sony's console, following previous appearances in the SNES, Prime Goal is a straightforward action game with simple arcade controls.  -Taiman batle: You need a memory card save to play this mode.

Correr a una velocidad de más de 200 millas por hora no es legal en la interestatal. Pero puede hacerlo todo lo que quiera en la pantalla de su televisor en NASCAR 98.
Elije 24 pilotos de NASCAR en este juego, cada uno conduciendo su auto característico. Con NASCAR 98, puede imaginar que eres un piloto profesional de NASCAR.

meta.name: NASCAR 98 Collector's Edition
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 285.80 MB

Racing at a speed of over 200 miles per hour isn't legal on the interstate. But you can do it all you want on your television screen in NASCAR 98.
 There are 24 top NASCAR drivers present in this game, each driving his signature car. Read their bios and choose your favorite to take on one of the 17 tracks in the game, 11 of which are officially licensed NASCAR circuits. Compete against the other 23 drivers by yourself or go head-to-head with a friend and six other cars. There are plenty of options available including control of the weather, difficulty, race length, and other rules. Choose from several racing views such as from behind the wheel and behind the car. Even make a pit stop if you have to.
 With NASCAR 98 you may just think you're a professional NASCAR driver yourself.
 Features:
 * Featuring 25 cars and drivers from the 1998 NASCAR season
 * Set your tires down on 11 official NASCAR Tracks and six fantasy courses
 * Play alone or with a friend in split-screen multiplayer action
 The Collector's Edition add these new features:
 - Race as or againts the King, Richard Petty in his trademark #43 car.
 - Compete at Darlington Raceway - NASCAR's original super speedway

Driver personalities, tense fender-to-fender tactics, and the white-knuckle anxiety of NASCAR's circuit speeds onto the PS in NASCAR 99. Skilled driving in Championship mode will unlock legendary drivers like Bobby Allison, Cale Yarborough, and Richard Petty.

meta.name: NASCAR Heat
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 467.00 MB

NASCAR HEAT has four different modes of play to choose from, based on the 2000 NASCAR Winston Cup Season. The game offers Single Race and Championship Season. These modes allow the player to choose their favorite driver and race against a full field of cars at one or all of the NASCAR tracks. Race the Pro and Beat the Heat Challenge are two modes of play that separate this product from the competition. Beat the Heat provides the player with a number of challenges designed around scenarios that actually occur in NASCAR. These challenges deal with everything from the best way to pass at a particular track, to pit strategy for tire changes. Race the Pro offers the player the opportunity to race against Laps actually driven by some of NASCAR's biggest stars.

meta.name: NASCAR Racing
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 288.80 MB

Nascar Racing features drivers based on their real-life counterparts from the 1996 Nascar season. Included are three modes of play -- arcade, simulation, and simulation testing -- and a variety of options. Simulation options available are: turn on or off driving aids, adjust tire pressure, adjust wheel settings, adjust aerodynamics, change gear settings, adjust shocks, angle cross weight, angle spoiler, and set wheel stagger.
 While racing, drivers will have to communicate with the pit crew to determine the tire temperature, how many tires to change, and how much to fill the fuel tank when you pit in. There are 16 licensed Nascar tracks included as well, three of which are night races. It's possible to race the full number of laps that actual Nascar drivers run or shorten a race to your liking.

meta.desc:

NASCAR Rumble es un juego de carreras de estilo arcade. 18 campos de carreras únicos en carretera y fuera de carretera se establecen en 6 áreas. 
Una variedad de coches especiales, tales como: el camión de pollo, bulldozer, carrito de golf, coche de motor a reacción, hot rod, se desbloquean a medida que avanza el juego. Cada coche tiene tres versiones, añadiendo más potencia y estilo. Numerosas power-ups incluyen: Twister, Nube de lluvia, Nitro, Big Hammer, Invincible, Freeze Steering, Oil y Bad Gas.
La dificultad del juego va desde "Kid Mode" hasta muy difícil. Powerups pueden ser desactivados. Las carreras están disponibles tanto en un jugador como de dos jugadores con pantalla dividida.

meta.name: NASCAR Thunder 2002
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 138.30 MB

EA SPORTS invita a los jugadores a regresar a las pistas para disfrutar de una experiencia de carreras de autos stock en 3D totalmente rediseñada en NASCAR Thunder 2002. A medida que las responsabilidades de desarrollo del lanzamiento anual de NASCAR de EA pasan a los últimos diseñadores de Madden NFL en Tiburon Entertainment, el título se refuerza con la palabra "Thunder" en honor a las extensas revisiones del juego y la nueva dirección de la serie.
Como en versiones anteriores, esta versión tiene licencia completa para presentar más de 60 pilotos de NASCAR de la vida real y las 23 pistas de la Copa Winston. Además de gráficos fluidos y detallados impulsados por una versión modificada del mismo motor de juego que impulsa Madden NFL 2001, esta versión también está diseñada para brindar más opciones de juego, modelado de daños preciso y una I.A. del oponente realista y estratégica.

meta.name: NASCAR Thunder 2003
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 149.30 MB

NASCAR Thunder 2003 simula la experiencia de pilotar en NASCAR. Hay docenas de ubicaciones disponibles, cada una con varias pistas alternativas. Todos los grandes nombres de los conductores del presente, y algunos del pasado, están disponibles para elegir, o puedes crear tu propio conductor y coche. Simula una temporada, o incluso una carrera completa de 20 años con ofertas de patrocinio y mejoras de automóviles en el camino. Los Momentos de la Carrera te sitúan en situaciones de carreras de la vida real, pidiéndote que dupliques el resultado de la realidad, o que lo mejore. O puedes competir contra hasta tres personas. La decisión es tuya.

meta.name: NASCAR Thunder 2004
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 262.40 MB

Puedes competir en una variedad de circuitos, desde 23 circuitos reales de la Copa Winston hasta 12 circuitos urbanos y 11 circuitos de fantasía, incluyendo un pueblo costero y una bulliciosa ciudad. Hay 60 desafíos en total.
Cuando compitas, tus acciones en la pista afectarán las carreras futuras. Si chocas contra un muro o provocas que alguien pierda el control, lo recordará. Intentará vengarse en una carrera posterior. Si ayudas a alguien despejando el camino o compartiendo el rebufo, te devolverá el favor. Los resentimientos y las alianzas se registran a lo largo de tu carrera, así que cuanto más molestes a alguien, más probabilidades habrá de que intente perjudicarte.

Konami returns to the world of basketball videogames with NBA IN THE ZONE '99, which includes all of the teams and players from the league. While all of the standard gameplay modes like Exhibition, Season, and Playoffs are included, two modes have been added: Slam Dunk Challenge and Three-Point Shootout. In the Slam Dunk Challenge, you choose the difficulty of your dunk and must memorize a series of button presses. The score for the dunk is determined by how well you recreate the button sequence. The Three-Point Shootout calls for you to stop a power bar in one of three locations to get the ball to go through the hoop. You have 60 seconds to shoot 25 balls, so you've got to be efficient if you want to win. No matter how you like your hoops action, you're sure to find what you want with NBA IN THE ZONE '99.

 Also beefed up is the AI. Not only will it be harder to drive to the basket, gamers have a greater chance of getting fouled-out, with increased foul elements such as offensive fouls and basket-count. So step on the court and get ready for some solid b-ball action.

Konami returns to the world of basketball videogames with NBA IN THE ZONE '99, which includes all of the teams and players from the league. While all of the standard gameplay modes like Exhibition, Season, and Playoffs are included, two modes have been added: Slam Dunk Challenge and Three-Point Shootout. In the Slam Dunk Challenge, you choose the difficulty of your dunk and must memorize a series of button presses. The score for the dunk is determined by how well you recreate the button sequence. The Three-Point Shootout calls for you to stop a power bar in one of three locations to get the ball to go through the hoop. You have 60 seconds to shoot 25 balls, so you've got to be efficient if you want to win. No matter how you like your hoops action, you're sure to find what you want with NBA IN THE ZONE '99.

NBA Shootout 2000 is the latest basketball game from 989 Sports. Motion-capture is provided by seven real NBA players, bringing the total to a staggering 300 different moves. Every NBA player is included here, along with all their signature moves. Some of the newer basic moves range from the Drop Step to the Killer Crossover.
 Authentic 3D players and arenas (with animated crowds) are recreated in the game and scaled to each player's actual height, weight and body style, in addition to clothing such as socks, wristbands, armbands, kneepads and hairstyles.
 Commentary is courtesy of Ian Eagle, and the different camera angles are presented in a TV telecast style. Dunks are also a huge part of the game with over 42 different ones within. If you cannot find one that you like then you can create up to 12 of your own, courtesy of the unique Create Dunk mode.
 Another big change here from previous versions is the Touch Shooting meter feature, which allows you to get a good feel for your shot. Holding the X-button, you must release it when the bar goes into either the green or yellow zone. If you release it in another zone, chances for hitting your shot are greatly decreased.
 Play with up to eight of your friends using two Multi Tap adapters. Enhance the gameplay by using a Dual Shock Analog Controller and make sure you save the game to any memory card. With playoffs, exhibition and full seasons, NBA Shootout 2000 will have you taking on all of your favorite NBA personalities.

For many seasons, 989's NBA ShootOut Series has competed with EA Sports' NBA Live for the position of top basketball game on the PlayStation market. NBA ShootOut 2001 shows no exception to this tradition. NBA ShootOut 2001 features a redesigned game engine that offers improved gameplay and smoother handling of the enhanced graphics offered by this title. To add to the realism, this game features over 400 motion-captured animations and arenas that are based on the actual stadiums that the NBA teams call home.
 NBA ShootOut 2001 features a refined "Touch Shooting" system that affords players even more control over the finesse shots. More dribbling options and controls are also available in NBA ShootOut 2001. The game is loaded with 450 plays for teams to execute on the hardwood. AI is also improved, allowing the computer defense to adjust to a particular style of offense, or for the computer's offense to choose a style that exploits weaknesses in the current method of defense.
 Features:
 Select your strategy from a playbook that includes over 450 different moves
 Featuring play-by-play commentary from Ian Eagle
 Play on the hardwood of arenas that are based on real-life basketball stadiums

Esta versión fue la base de muchas versiones, incluyendo muchos efectos Tridimensionales, debido a la similitud con Need For Speed III: Hot Pursuit muchos lo consideran como una actualización de la misma, incluso muchas pistas del Hot Pursuit estaban disponibles en la versión PC del juego.
