The Dekotora or Decotora, an abbreviation for "Decoration Truck", is a kind of loudly decorated truck most commonly found in Japan and the Philippines. Dekotora commonly have neon or ultraviolet lights, extravagant paints, and shiny stainless or golden exterior parts. These decorations can be found on both the cab and the trailer, and not only on the exterior but also in the interior. Dekotora may be created by workers out of their work trucks for fun, or they may be designed by hobbyists for special events. They are sometimes also referred to as Art Trucks.
 In 1976, Toei released the first entry in a series of 8 movies called Truck guys that featured as the protagonist a costumed trucker who drove his garishly decorated truck all over Japan. This movie was a big hit with both old and young, and caused a wave of Dekotora popularity to sweep the country. While Dekotoras were present throughout the 1970s, before the movie they were restricted to the north-eastern fishing transport trucks. It is possible that the movie was an attempt to popularise these kinds of trucks. In those days, ready-made parts for trucks were not easily available, so these trucks freely utilised parts from sightseeing buses or US military vehicles.
 Modern times:
 Since the late 1990s, Dekotora have been heavily influenced by the art of Gundam. In addition to the Gundam-influenced designs, it is common to see decorations that are more akin to modern art, or even retro designs that closely resemble those found in the movie Trucker.
 Equipment:
 There is a large amount of variation in the designs and equipment used in Dekotora, much of it owing to the individual tastes of the owners or groups that use the trucks.
 However, because the installation of these decorations can change the length, height and weight of the truck, for Dekotora used on highways for transportation and shipping these modifications have to pass inspection and be approved, and any departures from the regulations cleared.
 The Art comes from the delightful designs that can be added to the truck with a few bob in your pocket complete with flashing chilli lights for the dashboard a sign of good taste on the highways of Japan.
 Artcamion Sugorokuden is a board game using those art trucks and featuring up to 4 human players to play at the same time, the player can upgrade their trucks and transport items from one place to another to earn money and win the game.

A kayak is defined by the International Canoe Federation (the world sanctioning body) as a boat where the paddler faces forward, legs in front, using a double-bladed paddle. Most kayaks have closed decks, although "sit-on-top" kayaks are growing in popularity, as are inflatable kayaks which come without decks but which have air chambers surrounding the boat.

An out and out arcade game rather than a kayaking sim, Wild Rapids nonetheless delivers a realistic physics model giving just the right balance between player control and being buffeted by the water.

The Art comes from the delightful designs that can be added to the truck with a few bob in your pocket complete with flashing chilli lights for the dashboard a sign of good taste on the highways of Japan.

Dekotora may be created by workers out of their work trucks for fun, or they may be designed by hobbyists for special events. They are sometimes also referred to as Art Trucks.

The game's story, told tongue-in-cheek, casts players as generals, in charge of the queen's military and based in her castle. War is waged over long distances, with classic siege weapons and powerful magic.
			 The queen's two sisters each have their own armies and fortifications, and the battle will not be finished until only one castle is left standing. As the game progresses, castles collect tax revenue. Generals can use these funds to add new armaments, placing them where they'll do the most damage to the enemy, and also build additional defenses and repair damage that has already been done. Players are ranked according to their performances and may even earn a medal if they are especially successful on the battlefield.
			 Playing like Worms in 3D, or Worms 3D if you like, the idea is to raze your opponent?s castle to the ground through the use of cannons and catapults. These must to be aimed manually while taking wind speeds into consideration, and also need a few seconds to reload at which point both yourself and your enemy are vulnerable. New arsenal can be researched, including triple catapults, while later zeppelins and magic attacks such as thunderstorms become available. It was conceptualized by Nolan Bushnell and Steve Bristow, and influenced by the 1972 arcade game Pong, also by Atari. In addition, Breakout was the basis and inspiration for books, video games, film, and the Apple II personal computer.

To prevent this from happening, the player has a movable paddle to bounce the ball upward, keeping it in play.

Capitán Tsubasa J: Get In The Tomorrow es un videojuego de fútbol de acción con cinemáticas exclusivo de Japón lanzado en 1995 por Bandai para PlayStation. El juego es uno de los pocos que tiene dos modos: un modo de partido amistoso y un modo de historia en el que sigues la trama del animé real.
Modos de juego:
- Modo historia.
- El segundo es el Modo VS.
- Modo de torneo
MODO HISTORIA:
La historia comienza primero en la gran final de la Copa Mundial junior entre Japón y Alemania. Durante este primer partido, es probable que aprendas que es difícil anotar contra el arquero alemán, Deuter Muller. Sin embargo, cada vez que finalizas un partido, no importa si fue una derrota o un empate, tus jugadores obtienen puntos de experiencia que hacen que el próximo reintento sea más fácil.
Después de ganar una serie de juegos con Japan Junior, el enfoque cambia a Shingo Aoi tal como lo hace en el anime.
NIVELES DE JUGADOR:
Cada jugador puede alcanzar un máximo de nivel 100. Aumentar el nivel de un jugador aumenta todas sus estadísticas, incluida la velocidad, la potencia, la resistencia y el tiro. Jugadores particulares también aprenderán tiros especiales en ciertos niveles. Tenga en cuenta que el nivel de cada jugador corresponde solo a un equipo y un modo. Por ejemplo, el nivel de Tsubasa Oozora puede no ser el mismo al elegir Japón y Japón Junior. Asegúrate de guardar tus datos, ya sea en modo de historia o de partido amistoso.

Cowboy Bebop is a Japanese anime series. Directed by Shinichiro Watanabe and written by Keiko Nobumoto, the series was produced by Sunrise in the late 1990s. Its 26 episodes comprise a complete storyline: the series, set in 2071, follows the misadventures and tragedies of a group of bounty hunters, or "cowboys", traveling on their spaceship, the Bebop.
 Plot:
 The crew of the spaceship Bebop are a partnership of bounty hunters, called "cowboys", who travel the solar system trying to apprehend bounties. Jet Black is the owner of the Bebop, but has partnered with Spike for his diverse combat skills. Though he is reluctant to admit it, Jet has also come to rely on Spike for companionship in the normally solitary field of bounty hunting. In 2022, the explosion of an experimental warp gateway caused major damage to the Moon and the Earth, killing nearly all life and effectively ending Earth civilization. As a result, the survivors abandoned the now-uninhabitable Earth to colonize the inner planets and moons of Jupiter. Little to no knowledge remains of the history of Earth and humanity prior to the accident, creating a cultural void. In the show's timeline, decades after the accident, the entire solar system has been made accessible via reliable warp gates, but the crew of the Bebop regularly spends much of their time on Mars, the new central hub of human civilization.

A 3-D update of Nichibutsu's arcade classic, Crazy Climber 2000 takes the game play of the original and gives it a sweeping graphical makeover.
 Players control a man attempting to scale a series of skyscrapers with nothing more than his hands and feet. The building's tenants and a circling vulture will hurl various items at you, while a gorilla occasionally attempts to reach out and grab you. All of these obstacles must be avoided, along with the more routine danger of windows closing on your fingers.
 The game's buildings start out as square skyscrapers, but later levels introduce round buildings and new threats, such as homicidal window cleaners and falling rocks, to keep the climber from making it to the top.
 This new version also offers the player the ability to move from one face of a building to another. Included is the original Crazy Climber in all of its early 80s glory, and unlike the version included with Nichibutsu's previous arcade compilation, this one allows the use of the Playstation's dual shock analog sticks.

In terms of options, the game doesn’t offer much to tweak, only bookings, offsides, injuries, match length and the decider (simple or golden goal overtime and penalty shootout)

Densha de Go! is a Japanese train simulation game series originally produced by Taito and more recently by Square-Enix and Railfan Holdings Co., Ltd. The game originates from a 1996 arcade version. There are also PC versions released by the Japanese publisher Unbalance. All of the games in the series are available in Japanese only. The latest chapter in the series was released on June 15, 2011 for Apple iOS devices.
 Based on the 1996 arcade game, Densha de Go! was one of the first commercial train-driving simulation games, and went on to spawn numerous successors.
 The player can choose from a variety of tracks and trains and will then have to drive the train to the designated stations while sticking to the tight schedule, stopping exactly at the marked positions, obeying all signs and signals, and ensuring passenger safety and comfort.
 Whenever the player makes a mistake, points are deducted from a counter which at the start of each round is initialized to a value depending on the selected difficulty. If it reaches zero, the game is over.
 This title features, among others, the Yamanote Line around Tokyo, and parts of the To-kaido- Main Line.
 A special train conductor controller is available for almost every gaming platform that the game is released on, complete with levers, buttons, and a foot pedal to enhance game play.
 Densha de Go!, for Arcade, PS1, PC, WonderSwan, and Game Boy Color is the first in the series.
 Coverage: San'in Main Line (Sagano Line), Keihin-Tohoku Line, Tokaido Line (JR Kyoto Line) and Yamanote Line (portions of each of these).
 By the standard of later titles, this game was very strict, demanding that the user memorize routes. This strictness was caused by the fidelity of the PS1 and PC versions to the arcade version, where normal users it was generally hoped would not play for more than a few minutes per payment for economic reasons.
 The Windows port also includes the longer version of the Sagano Line from the EX version (see below), as well as an additional variation of the Tokaido JR Kyoto Line.

Horse Racing (US) or horseracing (UK) is an equestrian sport that has been practiced for millennia. It is inextricably associated with gambling. The common sobriquet for Thoroughbred horse racing is The Sport of Kings.
 Horse racing is an equestrian sport and major international industry, watched in almost every nation of the world. There are three types: "flat" racing; steeplechasing, i.e. racing over jumps; and harness racing, where horses trot or pace while pulling a driver in a small, light cart known as a sulky. A major part of horse racing's economic importance lies in the gambling associated with it, an activity that in 2008 generated a world-wide market worth around US$115 billion.
 Japan conducts more than 21,000 horse races a year in one of three types: flat racing, jump racing (races over hurdles), and Ban'ei Racing (also called Draft Racing).
 There are a total of thirty racetracks in Japan. Ten of these tracks are known as "central tracks", where most of Japan's top races are conducted. Races at these ten tracks are conducted by the Japan Racing Association (JRA), which operates under the oversight of the Japanese government. The remaining twenty tracks are operated by municipal racing authorities and run under the affiliation of the National Association of Racing (NAR). Two tracks, Sapporo Racecourse and Chukyo Racecourse, run separate meetings under either JRA or NAR jurisdiction.
 Derby Jockey began it's life on the Super Famicom and has evolved from 2-D racing to full blown 3-D featuring thundering hoofs and thrilling races. In DJ 2K1, you begin the game with an untrained horse who needs to be broken in and adapted to the ways of his new masters. Double Dragon es un juego de lucha derivado de la serie Double Dragon desarrollado y publicado por Technos Japan en 1995. Se basa en la película Double Dragon de 1994, que a su vez se basó en el juego de arcade original. Se lanzó originalmente para Neo Geo (en formatos AES y MVS) y luego se lanzó para Neo Geo CD y PlayStation (este último portado por Urban Plant). Fue el último juego Double Dragon de Technos Japan antes de que la empresa cerrara.
Es un juego de lucha convencional de su tiempo, es decir, las batallas son uno a uno y son al mejor de tres combates. Uno de los aspectos únicos de Double Dragon es la falta de botones específicos de golpe y patada como la mayoría de los juegos de lucha. En cambio, hay cuatro botones de ataque de diferente fuerza y ​​velocidad, que pueden dar puñetazos o patadas dependiendo de la posición del personaje. El personaje del jugador y su oponente tienen un medidor de súper movimiento llamado "medidor de carga", que se superpone a la salud restante del personaje. Cuanta menos salud tenga el personaje, más rápido se llenará. Los "movimientos de carga" generalmente se realizan ejecutando el comando de un movimiento especial regular y presionando dos botones de ataque simultáneamente al final en lugar de solo uno.

Freestyle Motocross: McGrath vs. Pastrana not only combines two of the sport's biggest stars, but also the two unique styles of motocross into one game. The game seeks to combine both freestyle and motocross into one event.

You can also choose to play a Single Race or run some Time Trials. And if you get tired of playing by yourself, grab a friend and go head to head in Multiplayer mode.

Ambientada en 2090, la historia de Front Mission se desarrolla en la isla Huffman, una ficticia isla del Océano Pacífico de aproximadamente el tamaño de Oahu, creada por la actividad volcánica al sur de la costa oeste de México en 1995. En 2002, la masa de la tierra se clasificó como una isla. y fue cedido al control de las Naciones Unidas. Sin embargo, en 2020, los Estados Unidos del Nuevo Continente (USN), una unificación de los países de América del Norte y América del Sur, hicieron una oferta por el control de la isla después de retirarse de las Naciones Unidas.
La Unión Cooperativa de Oceanía (OCU, por sus siglas en inglés), una alianza de naciones de Asia oriental y Australia que se creó en 2025, disputa esta afirmación cuando las dos superpotencias colonizaron la isla en 2065. Las tensiones aumentan y finalmente conducen al primer conflicto de Huffman en 2070. con la isla de Huffman dividida en dos mitades al final de la guerra. Una paz incómoda se mantiene hasta la crisis de Huffman en 2086, cuando una serie de escaramuzas en la isla causa el caos. Las tensiones aumentan y terminan en guerra cuando se culpa a la OCU por incitar el incidente de Larcus el 3 de junio de 2090.
La trama de Front Mission gira en torno al capitán de la OCU Royd Clive. Se asigna un pelotón de reconocimiento de la OCU dirigido por Royd para investigar una planta de municiones de la USN en el distrito de Larcus, ubicado en la isla oriental de Huffman. Al llegar a las instalaciones, el pelotón es emboscado por wanzers de la USN liderados por un oficial llamado Driscoll.

Gallop Racer is part horse racing simulation, part action/arcade racer.
When choosing horses for your stable, you have to take a lot of factors into account. For instance, is the horse a long or short distance runner? Does it do better on a dry track or a wet track? The factors appear to be endless at first.

The horse isn't really super, but it will almost certainly have a prolific career.

South Town, the spirited crime city in America. Once there was a man who owned and dictated the city. The man's name was Geese Howard. To defeat him, countless martial artists have met in South Town. La historia detrás del juego involucra a un hermano celoso (Garm) de un noble mago (Sumner) que decidió reunir 13 Rune Stones con el fin de criar un demonio. Grand Theft Auto: London 1969 es un paquete de expansión oficial para Grand Theft Auto. En lugar de las interpretaciones ficticias de Nueva York, Miami y Los Ángeles del original, este juego abre la ciudad de Londres para el jugador. El juego presenta treinta vehículos nuevos, nuevos gráficos y treinta y dos nuevas misiones; todo en un tema claramente británico. La serie se centra alrededor de diferentes protagonistas quienes intentan sobresalir en el mundo criminal.

Grille Logic is a difficult puzzle game in which the gameplay is to use the white form to the right over the left one after selecting the forms in the left side, complicated? Sure it is.
 The player has to first check the figure in the right and see what is missing there to put the proper colour arrows in the left one, when he's sure he can move the right figure over the left figure to check if he has solve the puzzle well or not, (the right figure will rotate to the left once for each colour arrows and if it match them is well solved) the "easier" way is to check each colour once since if the arrow colour are the right ones the game will give you more time to do the rest ones.
 After 10 levels the gameplay is the opposite one, since now it's time to create the proper spaces in the figure in the right so it match the colour arrows in the left figure.
 So, in resume a difficult game of skill and memory againts the limited time for each level...

Kazuyoshi Hoshino (born in Shizuoka, Shizuoka Prefecture, 1 July 1947) is a former racing driver and businessman from Japan.
 Hoshino's nickname was "the fastest man/guy in Japan". He won the Japanese motocross national championships in the 90cc and 125cc classes for Kawasaki in 1968 before switching to cars as a Nissan factory driver in 1969.
 Hoshino retired from racing in 2002 and now continues to run his own Super GT team and his own Nissan specialised aftermarket parts company, Impul.
 The Super GT series, formerly known as the All-Japan Grand Touring Car Championship or JGTC, is a grand touring car race series promoted by the GT-Association (GT-A). Though the JGTC was authorized by the Japan Automobile Federation and recognized by the FIA, the Super GT is authorized directly by FIA.

Gundam: the Battle Master is a Japanese fighting game involving robots who will try to attack and destroy each other. Before you start the game, you can choose from a various amount of robots, each being smaller or bigger, or having different attacks. As you progress the game, your opponents will get more difficult to beat. During a fight, your temperature bar will decrease when you manage not to get hit by your opponent.
All the robots will start with 4 levels of armor. As you attack your opponent with missiles and bazookas, his temperature bar will increase. You can aim your long range weapons by holding them to the direction you wish to shoot at. The game will be over when one of the robot's armors are fully destroyed or when time limit reaches zero and one robot has more armor than its opponent. Special moves requires energy from the energy cap, which is shown right below the temperature bar.
Your opponent will be beaten when he is overheated. When both robots are at the same level of armor, then the current temperature will decide the winner. You can block attacks in the air when you jump, but you cannot block when you are dashing.

Gunpey is a puzzle game set in the wild west. Your goal is to connect pieces of fuses to get one long fuse going across the board, making it explode and disappear.
 There are several game modes in Gunpey, such as the classical puzzle game modes "Endless mode", where you can either play until you mess up or timed, either for 2 or 5 minutes. "Stage mode", where you have to clear a certain amount of tiles before advancing to the next stage. "Puzzle mode", where you have a set amount of fuse pieces and you need to make them all go away in one explosion. And finally "Vs. mode", where you can face off against a friend.
 The game was named as a tribute to the developer of the game, Gunpei Yokoi who died from a car accident. He is also the designer of the Wonderswan and Nintendo's Game Boy system.
 Gameplay:
 Gunpey offers a one-of-a-kind puzzle experience. As lines of various angles climb up the screen, the player?s objective is to flip the lines, located in squares, to connect them over five columns. Connecting lines from left to right remove the connected row. If an incomplete line reaches the top of the screen, the game is over.
 The game got versions in the Wonderswam, Nintendo DS and PSP consoles.

meta.name: Hardcore 4X4
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 58.12 MB

TNN Motorsports Hardcore 4X4 simulates the sport of big truck racing rather than going with an Arcade format (like Midway's Off Road Challenge). This will require players to be on the lookout hazards in the road, pay attention to vehicle physics, choose trucks wisely, and adjust to various terrain and weather conditions.
 There are six different terrain/track locations -- Dynamite Pass, a mountainous setting of various terrain; Ground Zero Gulch, bumpy canyon driving; Devil's Kitchen, located in the dusty desert; Mercurial Forest, paved mountain roadways; Hades Highway, a volcano; and Arctic Inferno, a slippery ice capade. Depending on which track you happen to be on, you'll need to pick a truck well suited for the race. It would be pointless to take a rig built for winter driving when you're in the middle of the desert.
 Fortunately, there is a truck for every type of terrain (seven in all, one of which is hidden). If you're heading into Arctic Inferno, you'd probably be wise in choosing the Snow Spider -- a rig built with icy traction in mind. The Fire Witch is perfect for racing on hardened lava and the Sand Blaster rolls through sandy deserts like a knife through hot butter.
 Choosing the right truck really comes into play in the Championship mode of Hardcore 4X4. This is the main gameplay option; players will be facing off against five other trucks across each of the six tracks. The idea is to come in first on every track -- if you do, you'll reign as the champion! For the big rig masters, try the Championship mode on the Extreme difficulty; finish it and you'll unlock a new truck.
 There are two other options as well -- the Single Race and Time Trial. The Single Race is simply a race against five computer-controlled opponents and the Time Trial is a fierce competition for the fastest lap and finishing time on the given track. In the latter option, 8 people can compete for the glory -- the best times are then saved on your Memory Card.
 In addition to all this, TNN Motorsports Hardcore 4X4 comes equipped with three different difficulty levels (novice, pro, and extreme) and various weather conditions. You have the option of setting the weather to Good (normal conditions), Overcast (foggy conditions), and Severe (rain, snow, sandstorms, and smoke). Each setting effect tracks differently and will in someway interfere with your quest for glory (fog will hamper your vision, snow makes for messy driving, etc). There is also a day or night setting.
 Features
 Dynamite Pass, Arctic Inferno, Devil's Kitchen -- six hardcore courses in all
 Independent four-wheel suspension for realistic in-the-mud action
 Race in the day or night, through all sorts of weather

The Heiwa Otenki Studio is a collection of pachinko machines that features 2D cartoon characters and different levels of zoom. The game features the analog controller and dual shock function.
			This game features a good recreation of pachinko machines and the light effects.
			Pachinko is a Japanese gaming device used for amusement and prizes. Although pachinko machines were originally strictly mechanical, modern pachinko machines are a cross between a pinball machine and a video slot machine.
 The machines are widespread in establishments called "pachinko parlors", which also often feature a number of slot machines.  International Karate + is a 2D karate fighting game, but with three combatants instead of two. Taking control of one of the three karate experts, players must fight against the other two in timed rounds. The other two karate experts are fighting against each other as well, creating a three way fight situation.
 Each fighter starts with an empty gauge that can record up to five points. Every time a fighter makes a successful attack on either of the two other fighters he earns a point in his gauge, as well as a score depending on the technique. The first fighter to get five full points is the winner of the round, but the fighter with the second highest point total can continue to fight in the next round. If none of the fighters are able to score five points before the timer runs down then the two fighters with the highest point totals move on to the next round, while the third fighter is dropped. In the case of a point tie the fighter with the higher cumulative score is the winner.
 Between rounds players can engage in a mini-game which involves holding a shield and deflecting balls bouncing into the screen from both directions. Players can hold the shield facing either direction and at one of three heights. The goal is to deflect as many balls as possible without letting one slip through.

Esta entrega fue anunciada por SNK como una "edición especial" de la serie, ya que contó con la mayoría de los personajes aparecidos en los juegos anteriores (de KOF '94 al '97), incluyendo a los que habían muerto en la historia.

Una década más tarde salió un remake para PlayStation 2 como The King of Fighters '98: Ultimate Match, el cual expande el número de personajes.
Al carecer de historia, SNK aprovechó para incluir a Rugal (quien había muerto en KOF '95), así como varias versiones alternativas de otros personajes. KOF '98 es comúnmente considerado por muchas publicaciones como el mejor KOF debido a sus gráficos y accesible jugabilidad.

meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 5.26 MB

In Korokoro Post Nin the player controls Akane, a newspaper delivery girl, and she has to deliver a paper to each mailbox on the stage before she can use the exit. 
Since her newspaper delivery route covers a crazy topsy-turvy neighborhood with no fixed up or down, it's a good thing that the player can rotate the world around herself at will, so that no matter which way the player wants to go it's always downhill as far as he's concerned. Of course, the player has got to watch out that he don't rotate something nasty like spikes, carnivorous plants, or vending machines in his way, and he certainly want to collect all the spare change and lucky cat statues lying around. Oh, and deliver papers to all the houses within the time limit so that he can continue on to the next neighborhood, of course. 
Rotating the entire screen around your character at will is a slick and impressive effect apparently handled effortlessly by the ol' PS1 and while it takes some getting used to, it quickly becomes near second nature. 
Akane will run faster if she's touching the wall than if she's in free fall - meaning you spend a lot of time hugging the walls rather than drifting across open spaces to your goal. 
There's a small radar showing the un-delivered mailboxes in the corner, which comes in very handy in later levels. Every time she delivers a paper she shouts "Shinbun!" Shinbun is, of course, Japanese for "newspaper". There are occasionally enemies in your path, and the only way to kill them is to tilt the platform so steeply Akane runs through them. She makes a happy sound and a 'motion trail' follows her when she reaches this speed. There are also barriers that need to be smashed this way later on.

Diseñado y desarrollado por Davilex, London Racer te pone al volante para que pases a toda velocidad por St Paul's, corras por Regents Street y quemes goma en el Big Ben. Al entrar en el juego como un novato en una carrera callejera ilegal, London Racer permite al jugador desarrollar su habilidad y conducir finalmente un coche GT por una selección de circuitos londinenses.
Se incluyen tres tipos de carrera: Carrera rápida para que un solo jugador se persiga en un circuito de su elección, Time Trail para desafiar a auténticos fanáticos de la velocidad y Tournament, una carrera trepidante contra oponentes dentro de 3 ligas. Time Trail desafía a los mejores pilotos a enfrentarse a otros seis y, con cada contrincante totalmente equipado con un alto nivel de Inteligencia Artificial (IA), los resultados son un concurso de habilidad, rapidez mental y mucha interacción divertida. En el año 2050, 10 años después del incidente de Sharon Apple en Macross plus cuando unos terroristas desafían al gobierno y éste decide mandar un escuadrón de VFX ravens para mantener la paz. El problema es que la corporación "crítical path" bajo el mando de Manfred Brando desarrolló un arma nueva que hace inútiles los sistemas de armas de los enemigos con lo que al controlar este mecanismo tienen la victoria asegurada. Los terroristas son los "Black Ravens" y su líder es un tal Timoshie Daldahnton conocido por el nick de All kill wizard. 
Tu eres Aegis Focker miembro del escuadrón alpha de los VFX Raven que fue enviado para contraatacar a los terroristas y evitar que consigan esta arma secreta. Tu tendrás que pilotear la más avanzada maquina de vuelo de la UN.
Pero no todo es lo que parece. Hay un traidor que simpatiza con los terroristas. ¿Quién puede ser? ¿Tu controladora de misión? ¿Tu soporte? ¿Tu capitán? ¿Quizás tu comandante?
La única manera de averiguarlo es jugar el juego completo. Puedes salvar a los colonos, ser leal a tus amigos, atacar a los terroristas y hasta detener la destrucción del SDF Macross. O puede que no. Esto dependerá del camino que elijas...

meta.name: Mad Panic Coaster
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.93 MB

In Mad Panic Coaster, you control a boy and a girl (perhaps a brother and sister?) as they sit in a roller coaster car and go through 15 hellish roller coasters. How these roller coasters even got past safety testing is unknown, as they don't have any rails or barriers of any sort. It's up to you to steer the roller coaster car using the d-pad to make sure it stays on the track. The roller coasters also have various monsters, traps, and jumps to avoid. To do this, you use X to jump. Hitting Square will make the girl throw some sort of yellow ball projectile that explodes at a long range, while hitting Circle will make the boy throw that same type of projectile at a shorter range. Falling off the track or getting hit by something will cost you health, and once you run out, you must start the level all over again. Once you make three laps around the track, a rainbow with the words "lucky" form around you as they come to a stop, and you move on to the next level. Every three roller coasters, a boss will be fought after completing the third lap. This boss is similar to the regular enemies, except that they take many more hits to kill. To defeat them, you has to either throw enough projectiles at them or survive another three laps.
The levels take you through a plethora of locations, ranging from scary castles to the ocean to Wonderland to the inner cities. Each roller coaster has its own unique enemies, and while the game may move too fast for you to see these enemies in close detail, pausing can show that a lot of work went into these details. Most of the game is constructed out of polygons, but the boy and girl are sprites, allowing them to appear more expressive than PS1-era polygonal characters would typically allow. The music, while slightly limited in terms of variety, is fitting for what goes on in the game, consisting mainly of instrumental thrash metal and hardcore punk tracks.

Dos de ellos, llamados “Hound Dog” y “Rising Dog”, se ponen bajo el control de la policía para uso experimental. Sin embargo, la computadora principal a bordo de la nave de guerra llamada “Omega” se activa repentinamente y accede a las redes militares, congela todas las funciones de la ciudad Artemis y le ordena a Rising Dog acabar con el enemigo. Hound Dog y su piloto, no afectados por Omega, son enviados por la policía para contrarrestar el ataque y destruir a todos los robots enemigos.

-Modo Versus

Mejorada la ejecución y la interfaz rush, gracias a lo cual te permite tener más control sobre la estrategia y la ejecución de tus jugadas. The industry's most enduringly popular football game returns to the PlayStation with this 2002 edition, once again bringing familiar gameplay and new features. As always, teams and rosters have been updated to match those of the most recent (2000-2001) NFL season and the game features commentary from perennial hosts John Madden and Pat Summerall, including some new, more player-specific content. In addition to the modes of play offered in earlier versions of Madden NFL, players can now buck up on the basics in a Training Mode or play through the intensity of the Two-Minute Drill. There are also the options of Tournament play and Custom Leagues, as well as the new Create-A-Team feature.

The game of football just got more real with Madden NFL 2003. This year's installment of the Madden NFL Football series features more depth, new animation, realistic player AI, and in-depth play modes. Hop on John Madden's Cruiser Tour Bus and travel to all NFL cities to complete skilled tasks in the all-new Mini-Camp mode. The improved graphics and presentation now show sidearm QBs, gang-tackling, stand-still receiver catches, and more than 300 realistic player faces. Madden NFL 2003 gives you more control than ever before, with faster game speed, a more finely tuned passing game, and independent audibles for defensive line, linebackers, and defensive backs.

meta.desc:

Probablemente la franquicia de videojuegos deportivos más exitosa y reconocible de su época, Madden NFL regresa a consolas y computadoras para su decimocuarta temporada de acción en el fútbol profesional. Como de costumbre, los equipos, plantillas, logotipos y estadios han sido actualizados según la información más reciente de la temporada de la NFL 2002-2003.
Al Michaels, de Monday Night Football, se une nuevamente a John Madden para narrar las jugadas y ofrecer comentarios, mientras una Melissa Stark virtual da reportes desde la línea lateral.

Sin embargo, muchas de las novedades de este año afectan a los propios jugadores de la NFL, que exigen a los jugadores que mantengan y desarrollen a sus atletas estrella. Ahora se recompensa a los jugadores por sus buenas actuaciones a lo largo de la temporada, y los individuos pueden verse afectados por el flujo y reflujo de la moral.

Magic Carpet para PlayStation es una conversión de un clásico de PC. Volar sobre una alfombra es original en los videojuegos, pero el concepto y la historia lo hacen único. Recoge poderes mágicos disparando las bolas (mana) que flotan alrededor del mundo y hazlas de tu color (blanco). Luego, deja que tus globos aerostáticos los recojan y los lleven a tu castillo antes de que los otros magos tomen tu maná y lo cambien a su propio color. Hay 13 bestias diferentes que vuelan o caminan en cada uno de los 75 mundos, un aspecto realmente interesante del maná es que puedes acceder a más hechizos cuanto más obtienes, en total hay 20 hechizos diferentes que se pueden encontrar a lo largo del juego.

Data East consiguió en 1996, un enorme éxito con Magical Drop II. De aspecto similar a Bust-A-Move de Taito, ofrecía cambios en la jugabilidad que lo hacían sumamente entretenido. En una industria con tanta competencia, era imperativo aprovechar el filón, y la empresa no tardó en programar una tercera parte para la placa Neo Geo, en un acertado intento de mantener el éxito cosechado hasta entonces.
Magical Drop III ve la luz en 1997, y nos trae lo mejor de esa segunda parte, eliminando alguna que otra carencia, sobretodo en lo que se refiere a su elevada dificultad. En general será bastante más completo en modos de juego, y evolucionado tanto a nivel sonoro como gráfico.    Como ya hiciera la segunda entrega, los personajes a elegiur provienen de las cartas del Tarot, aunque en esta ocasión vendrán las 22 cartas y no sólo una selección: World (el Mundo), Fool (el Loco), Magician (el Mago), High Priestess (la Sacerdotisa), Empress (la Emperatriz), Emperor (el Emperador), Hierophant (el Sumo Sacerdote)... Todos los personajes han sido diseñados con un estilo que se acerca al manga, pero que coge igualmente tintes cartoon, incluso un aire marcadamente cómico.

Cada personaje tiene un movimiento especial para matar a los enemigos. A diferencia de otros juegos de plataforma 3D, Pandemonium ofrece solo desplazamiento en 2D en lugar de libertas total de movimiento. Los personajes se mueven en un escenario con un ambiente en 3D

Una vez más, ¡a por todas! Así que el Pollo Loco fue enviado de vacaciones a la orilla del mar, pero allí no consiguió nada de paz y tranquilidad. Pero ya no era la única víctima. El Lesshuhn, su primo pueblerino un poco imbécil y, por lo tanto, casi extinguido, vino de visita.

Moorhuhn (distributed as Crazy Chicken in English-speaking countries) is a German casual game franchise for PCs and the Nintendo DS. It consists of more than 30 games, the first of which - a shoot 'em up - was Germany's most popular computer game in the early 2000s. Originally the star of an promotional campaign for undrinkable whiskey Jack Daniels, Moorhunh has starred in over thirty games during the years, including five kart racing games.
 Moorhuhn 2 - Die Jagd Geht Weiter gameplay is like the first Moorhuhn game, the hunter in front of the screen must shoot down as many grouse as possible in 90 seconds. This generates points. That's it. Simple, but effective!
 Certain basic principles remain the same: 90 seconds, grouse flying around the landscape, shooting the above (the grouse, not the landscape!!!) yields points.
 That was enough for part one, but there had to be more in the sequel. So the game this time is filled with loads of hidden puzzles to solve in order to spur on the fans' passion for the hunt.

 Moorhuhn Kart is a kart racing game. The game features five generic locations (countryside level, a slippery ice level, a mountain level with dangerous sections,a desert level and the last lap of the Grand Prix takes places in a fiery lava level), five characters and a set of weapons.
 Player can either try to beat the tracks in the Grand Prix mode, against three computer-controlled players, or beat the best times on their own in the Time Trial mode. While racing, there are power-ups to collect, such as turbo to increase the speed, chewing gum to make the other karts get stuck, and an egg to throw to slow another car down. Players can choose from 5 characters: Moorhuhn, Lesshuhn, Moorfrosh, Pumpkin and Schneemann.

El camino a través del juego te permite sumergirte cada vez más en una de las más interesantes y emocionantes aventuras del universo de Mortal Kombat. Ábrete camino a través de complejos mundos tridimensionales y destruye a tus enemigos con técnicas de lucha, movimientos especiales y combos completamente nuevos: ¡te espera un final espectacular! CARACTERÍSTICAS: - Lucha a través de cinco monstruosos niveles en 3D como un Jax endurecido por la batalla - Componente estratégico gracias a una variedad de diferentes tipos de armas - Nuevo modo de francotirador y sistema de combinación revisado - Oponentes y jefes con dificultad progresivamente creciente - Sofisticado sistema de combate - Una nueva y excitante capital en la saga de culto Mortal Kombat.

meta.desc:

Mortal Kombat II e similar a su antecesor, pero presenta una serie de mejoras, como una mejora gráfica, mejores efectos de sonido, un juego más rápido (y más difícil), una animación más fluida y más personajes (incluido un Shang Tsung jugable).
Naturalmente, el juego es violento e incluye además del conocido Fatality, se agregaron "Babalities" y "Friendships" para apaciguar (en realidad, burlarse de) los grupos de ciudadanos preocupados por el alto nivel de sangre y gore de la serie. Estos movimientos un poco más amables y suaves incluyen cosas como convertir a tu oponente en un bebé y darle un ramo de flores.

meta.name: Mortal Kombat 3
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 25.81 MB

¿No está claro qué sucedió al final de Mortal Kombat II? La respuesta es: más Kombat! Mortal Kombat 3 es la tercera entrega del juego que enfurece a los congresistas de todas partes. Después de que los Kombatants perdieron el segundo torneo en Outworld, el hogar de dimensiones alternativas  Shao Kahn y su hechicero Shang Tsung, Kahn decidió apoderarse de la Tierra como lo haría cualquier villano. Conquistando las almas de todos menos unos pocos terrícolas seleccionados, Kahn prepara guerreros propios para enfrentarse a Liu Kang y Sub-Zero de frente.
Controlas a 14 luchadores seleccionables (y uno oculto) con los botones estándar de dos golpes, dos patadas y bloqueo, además de una nueva característica, el botón de correr. MK3 también agrega combos de múltiples golpes y ascensión de nivel (básicamente, golpeas a un luchador por el techo y termina en otra pantalla).

meta.name: Mortal Kombat Mythologies : Sub-Zero
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 16.87 MB

Midway decidió hacer algo un poco diferente con su franquicia de Mortal Kombat. Decidieron que en lugar de hacer un juego MK completamente nuevo, harían un juego que se centrara en un personaje en particular de la popular serie; un mini MK si se quiere. Iluminarían a los jugadores del pasado y del presente con una historia, en lugar de peleas sin sentido para ganar un torneo. El personaje elegido es Sub Zero, y el juego se llama acertadamente Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub Zero.
Mythologies sigue siendo fiel a su serie madre (hasta Mortal Kombat 4, de todos modos) en algunos aspectos: todos los personajes están digitalizados y el juego sigue siendo 2D. Pero a diferencia de los otros juegos de la serie, éste es una aventura de plataformas. No sólo luchas por ganar un torneo, sino por descubrir toda la historia de Sub Zero. Claro que seguirás golpeando a muchos malos, pero el juego es básicamente un juego de "salto de plataforma a plataforma". A mitad de camino incluso se añaden algunos elementos de RPG, como la colección de objetos y una pantalla de menú, para darle un poco de sabor a las cosas.

meta.name: Mortal Kombat Trilogy
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 41.10 MB

El segundo juego de Mortal Kombat en PlayStation combina personajes, etapas y movimientos de entregas anteriores en la violenta serie de combates. Elige entre un total de 36 personajes jugables, incluidas las versiones alternativas de Kano, Jax, Raiden, Sub-Zero y Kung Lao. Al igual que en juegos anteriores, debes luchar y vencer a cada oponente en sucesión en tu misión para enfrentarte al malvado Shao Khan. Cada combate es al mejor de tres que implica agotar la salud de un rival, en cuyo punto puedes iniciar un movimiento de "calidad" específico del personaje: Fatality, Animality, Babality o Brutality.
Una de las nuevas características clave en Mortal Kombat Trilogy es el "Modo Aggressor Kombat". Los combos de aterrizaje llenan un medidor horizontal que, cuando está al máximo, permite a los personajes desatar ataques aún más poderosos. Además del modo arcade para un solo jugador, los jugadores pueden desafiar a un amigo en una pelea uno contra uno, una batalla de dos contra dos o participar en un torneo round-robin que abarca ocho combatientes. La derrota de Shao Khan tiene el beneficio adicional de desbloquear hasta 12 cajas del tesoro, con sorpresas que van desde un minijuego de Galaga hasta demostraciones en video de las muertes del título.

Motor Mash, on the other hand, is a top down cartoon racer that aims more for those evening when you gather a few mates together for 'a bit of a laugh', stocked up with a crate of beer. Bumping and barging through the pack, blowing each other up with crazy weapons, easing an opponent off the screen and out of the race, fast frantic action that may gain you many trophies but kill off all of your pals - metaphorically, of course.
 As one of the twelve wacky characters you can race across more than forty themed levels, each with their own unique hazards. Each of the characters has a number of weapons at their disposal which may be used to obliterate the opposition.
 There should be no confusion as to who is racing which vehicle because they each have their own distinct shape, color and driver. Cabby drives a large yellow taxi, Pretty prefers a red truck while Hippy obviously could not make up his mind and opted for a multicolored 60's style bus. Other vehicles include a submarine, tank, rocket and a cool ice cream van.

Motor Toon GP 2 es una imaginativa montaña rusa de dibujos animados ambientada en una serie de mundos estrafalarios con grandes similitudes entre una mezcla de Mario Kart y Wipeout. Motor Toon Grand Prix 2 de Sony lleva las carreras a un mundo furiosamente deformado de imágenes de dibujos animados y luces brillantes. Visualmente, el juego es espectacular y lleva a los jugadores por lugares como castillos encantados, carreteras de cristal, volcanes y otros escenarios de dibujos animados. Motor Toon GP2 cuenta con más de diez circuitos y ocho corredores, cada uno con habilidades y destrezas diferentes. A diferencia de muchos otros títulos de carácter simpático e infantil, Motor Toon GP2 no es apto para pusilánimes e incluye cinco niveles de dificultad. Motor Toon Grand Prix 2 también aprovecha la función de enlace de Sony y se incluye una copia del juego en un segundo disco.

Los cuatro modos de juego incluyen Time Attack, League, Head-to-Head y Single Race. Cada modo ofrece la opción de ver la acción a 30 o 60 fotogramas por segundo (25 o 50 en versión PAL), siendo la diferencia clave la cantidad de autos controlados por computadora en la pista.
Características:

MTV Sports: Pure Ride is a multi-event snowboarding game that brings trick and stunt action, as well as high-speed downhill jaunts, to the PlayStation. The game contains a number of different snowboarding characters from around the world -- most of them are fictitious, and some are quite wacky in their design. -- and a variety of boards for snow shredding. Each rider and board has his or her (or its) own strengths and weaknesses.
			For those who aren't down with a bunch of silly rules, Free Ride mode allows players to hit the slopes free of score or trick requirements to simply enjoy the thrill of snowboarding. In Tour Challenge, an around-the-world jaunt, there are a number of different requirements for passing levels. There are five different tours to choose from and 12 different events to take on. Beating different levels will release them for use in Free Ride.
			If you're the type that eschews variety for specialization, then the Specialist mode is for you. In this mode, players can take on specific types of challenges, ranging from Big Air to Slopestyle to Half-pipe, shredding through 12 courses to unlock more levels. Stunt Mode rounds out the different ways to play Pure Ride, and in it players must complete 18 stages, hitting a variety of tricks to progress.
			There is also a two-player feature that allows multiple snowboarders to take each other on in a myriad of events. And if you enjoy making your own levels, prepare to rejoice, for Pure Ride allows you to construct your own slopes, making them as tame or insane as you like.

MTV Sports Skateboarding featuring Andy McDonald is the first game from the MTV Sports line, and like Tony Hawk's Pro Skater, it combines real elements of the sport with fantastic tricks and parks that would be impossible to recreate in real life.
			The game features a mix of real professional boarders and fantasy characters, and highlights venues from around the world. Every character has the same set of tricks, but they have different stats when it comes to attributes such as balance and jump height. The levels have a number of different goals for players to accomplish, but the only true way to pass a level is to rank high in a judging that takes place at the end of the run.
			Along with the standard bunch of tricks it brings to the table, MTV Sports Skateboarding features an extended system for flat land tricks, allowing for the possibility of even larger combos. There are a number of different game modes, including career, multiplayer and training modes, as well as a high score mode and an Icon Mode where you must find hidden MTV icons before time runs out. The soundtrack contains music from the likes of The Deftones, Cypress Hill, and Pennywise.

MTV Sports: Snowboarding is an extreme sports game where you have to perform tricks on your snowboard. You can opt to play with one of six different boarders, with each their own abilities. The game features five game modes: qualifying, challenge, create-a-park, head-to-head and training. The qualifying mode offers three levels where you have to score enough points to unlock the challenge mode, where you can challenge other boarders in trick events or races. The create-a-park mode allows you to create your own track to play on. head-to-head allows you to play a multiplayer match against a friend. The available tracks come in four general types: mountain X, big air contest, half-pipe and slopestyle.

La historia comienza con los Muppets que asisten a la lectura del testamento del tío  del Dr. Honeydew. En lugar de ir de vacaciones a un resort tropical, Robin y los demás se encuentran en un destartalado y espeluznante castillo. Al llegar Kermit, Miss Piggy, Fozzy y otros son capturados y ahora le toca al joven Robin (sobrino de Kermit) salvar el día.
Tienes que explorar todas las áreas y recoger gemas y fichas. Para obtener el 100% tiene que explorar cada esquina y averiguar cómo llegar a las plataformas de difícil acceso.
En los primeros niveles, Robin gana cuatro poderes especiales al recoger monedas Muppet especiales. Cuando se recogen todas las monedas de un grupo, Robin puede transformarse en diferentes tipos de monstruos en ciertos lugares. Aparecerá un icono en la esquina superior derecha, indicando que puede utilizar esta habilidad especial. Puede volar o flotar, escalar ciertas paredes, hacer un corte de karate para romper obstáculos, o ganar fuerza extra para empujar objetos.

Each Muppet movie, 'The Muppet Movie', 'The Great Muppet Caper', 'Muppets Take Manhattan', 'The Muppet Christmas Carol', 'Muppet Treasure Island', and 'Muppets From Space', has 4 related tracks. Therefore, 24 courses in total.
At the outset there are 8 Muppet drivers available: Kermit, Miss Piggy, Fozzie, Rizzo, Gonzo, Beaker, Rowlf, and Animal. As a reward for winning races more characters are unlocked - with 17 other Muppet stars made available.
Also included, are FMV scenes taken from each movie.

More than 30 recipes are provided by FamilyFun Magazine, utilizing a fully stocked refrigerator and pantry in My Disney Kitchen. Gameplay encourages experimentation with ingredients, setting the table, arranging the room, serving food, and topping off concoctions with syrup, berries, and more.

Además de eso, trata de mantener el equilibrio mientras eres bombardeado con misiles y otras armas por otros cinco corredores. N.GEN Racing tiene todo esto y más.
Todas las características de tus juegos de carreras favoritos están aquí. Desde la compra de otras naves hasta la personalización de las características de cada uno, N.GEN Racing lo pone directamente en control de esto y mucho más. En el modo Arcade, el jugador puede divertirse corriendo sin ninguna otra complicación. El Campeonato Arcade permite a los jugadores volar a través de varios circuitos con su selección de naves y ganar para desbloquear la próxima clase de campeonato.

En algún lugar profundo en el futuro, nuestra Galaxia está en guerra. En el cercano planeta Neptuno, las fuerzas del mal han iniciado sus nuevos planes para invadir la Tierra. Al acelerar partículas subatómicas alrededor de un circuito de forma tubular conocido como The Torus, están desarrollando una raza de Super Guerreros. Junto con la ingeniería genética avanzada, este canal central es capaz de producir un ejército de insectos mutados genéticamente letales. El óxido nitroso, un subproducto contaminante emitido dentro de The Torus, proporciona un combustible de alto octanaje para su 'Tunnel Runner', pero desafortunadamente también proporciona el entorno de reproducción perfecto para las especies que se incuban en secreto.

Night Raid is the fourth shmup by Takumi. Apparently a rushed-up job (in the sense that Taito forced the development in a few moments, to have more wiggling shmups,so to speak) it runs on G-Net hardware and features an interesting but a bit unpolished gameplay, questionable graphics and a great soundtrack.
 Night Raid employs a unique twist on the "sub-weapon that makes you invincible" system. The Hug Launcher must be shot at an enemy and only if it hits something do you become invincible: i.e., you can't use it as a last-ditch escape from pastel maelstrom death, you have to plan it?s use deliberately. And the Hug Launcher does not have a specified time over which it is effective.
 By repeatedly tapping the X-Button once you've released the attack, you can begin to build a combo, so long as there are enemies on the screen (you can get even higher combos by directing the Hug Launcher with the control pad as you tap X), at this point, your ship is invulnerable, so keep your eye on where the Hug Launcher is going.
 One thing that does irk me though is that both of the intros (the arcade intro and a new rendered home intro) are both FMV when its obvious that the original arcade intro was real-time
 The PSX version removed the 2001 arcade version's 2-player option.

El primer juego emplea un estilo de horror gótico; en el año 1666 una sociedad secreta conocida como la Hermandad de Hécate busca crear una nueva raza de super hombres para conquistar Londres y luego el mundo.
La Hermandad comenzó a robar cadáveres para aislar un agente viral extremadamente poderoso, una mezcla de plaga, rabia y conjuros arcanos desconocidos que dotaría a cualquier humano de fuerza inimaginable. En 1834 reaparecen los rumores sobre monstruos que merodean en la oscuridad y cadáveres saliendo de sus tumbas. Un misterioso manuscrito llega a manos de Ignatius Blackward, quien logra descifrar una pequeña porción, descubriendo que se trata del diario de aquél miembro de la Hermandad que puso fin a su maligno plan 170 años atrás. El juego emplea una cámara en tercera persona con varias secciones de plataforma y combates; podemos elegir entre los dos personajes, quienes tienen diferentes estilos y combos.

Lanzado durante el 20º aniversario de la creación del popular juego de arcade Pac-Man. Es un juego de plataformas libres en tres dimensiones disponible para la consola PlayStation
El juego es una plataforma 3D estándar de tipo lineal cuyo tema central es la historia del personaje, cada uno de los 17 niveles presenta un laberinto que se rige por las reglas del juego original (aunque el símbolo PAC sigue presente, permitiendo al jugador sobrevivir hasta cuatro veces el toque de los fantasmas). Cada nivel está lleno de pac-puntos, frutas y fantasmas, gran parte de la música fue modificada de entradas anteriores de la serie (uno de los temas comunes en todos los niveles es la música de intermedio de Pac-Man modificada de acuerdo con el tema del nivel, y remasterizada) y el juego de arcade original Pac-Man está disponible para jugar desde la pantalla de menú.
Además, a Pac-Man se le dieron unas cuantas maniobras estándar de plataforma, incluyendo salto y un rebote, que recuerda al de Mario y un movimiento que le permite rodar a alta velocidad, similar al de Sonic The Hedgehog. Asimismo, adquirió la capacidad de utilizar los pac-puntos ofensivamente, arrojándolos hacia enemigos que no fuesen fantasmas. Esta maniobra al ser ejecutada sin soltar el botón, puede provocar una explosión donde se usan 10 de esos puntos, ideal para rivales muy difíciles. Además, se introdujo la capacidad de nadar. Se introdujeron los trampolines b-doing, para rebote y movimiento superior.

A high school girl named Kaoru found him abandoned in a box outside her house one rainy afternoon, and decided to take him in. Her dog-hating mother, however, didn't appreciate this, and after a month of putting up with puppy problems, she insisted that Kaoru get rid of it.
 But Kaoru didn't exactly have much of a chance to do this, since she had apparently been targetted by an evil organization fronted by none other than the world-famous prophet Nostradamus. And while our brave little puppy tried his hardest to take on the war-machine sent to abduct her, the battle ended with exactly the fate you'd expect when a puppy squares off against a war-machine. Bruised, battered, and on his own, poor little Pal seemed to be in a hopeless situation...
 ...until Zeus stepped in, anyway! After passing a series of trials, Pal is endowed with the ability to take on any shape of his choosing. Taking on a humanoid warrior-like appearance he is accompanied back to the human world by the Poverty God and the Mountain Goddess, and sets off to solve the mystery of Kaoru's whereabouts, and to figure out, once and for all, what the motives of Nostradamus and his minions really are.
 And he also enlists the help of Kaoru's boyfriend Yukito, who is apparently quite an expert chef.
 A new system in Pal gives the player the ability to cook different types of soups, casseroles and baked dishes that have different effects. A simple potion can be whipped up which will heal your wounds while a steaming broth can serve as a cure for poison. All dishes must be learned before you can make them but the cooking system is user friendly and easy to get into.

La pantera rosa recibe una carta de parte de su tío, el cual le indica que debe llegar hasta su hogar. En el camino, la pantera rosa recuerda que su tío era como un héroe para el, pero también pensaba que había muerto ya que lo devoró un dinosaurio. Luego, el jugador (que hace el papel de la pantera), tiene que recorrer toda la casa del tío de la pantera, que está compuesta por doce niveles, hasta llegar al ático en donde se esconde un tesoro heredado por parte del tío de la pantera. Cada nivel está compuesto por un gran escenario (donde se basa en uno de los viajes del tío de la pantera) el cual consiste en que la pantera tiene que robar objetos de un individuo. Éste individuo se enfada y persigue a la pantera hasta que ésta pueda ganar entregando dicho objeto a otro, para que éste le permita entrar en otras partes de un nivel, para que finalmente la pantera consiga robar la llave del escenario que la ayudará a pasar de nivel. Además el juego posee niveles especiales donde la pantera rosa tiene que patinar y esquivar los obstáculos en el camino para ganar el nivel. Otros niveles minoritarios consisten en que la pantera rosa debe vencer a un jefe a través de la utilización de explosivos. En el nivel final, la pantera rosa tiene que enfrentarse a una versión antagonista y animada del Inspector Clouseau. Después de vencerlo se descubre que el tío de la pantera no estaba muerto y quería que la pantera le recuperase el tesoro para luego escaparse con él. Sin embargo la pantera rosa quedó confundida y molesta por la situación, por lo que persiguió a su tío por la ciudad.

Set in the 23rd century, Pitball is the only sport left in existence. There are no rules in this violent battle -- your objective is simply to score as many goals as possible while destroying the other team.
 Before jumping into the action, you'll select from one of twelve available teams. Consisting of two players per roster, teams include human beings and various alien races, each with their own distinctive forms of attack. While the Arquons utilize a series of oceanic attacks, the stone creatures of the Slorillians use volcanic rock to decimate their opponents.
 In this brutal sport, the idea is to smash up the other team in an attempt to make them drop the ball; the ball is made of pure energy. To help your team become stronger, you can purchase items and free agents. Money is gained from bank loans, team sponsors and by placing bets on games. While on the playing field, your team can obtain special power-up items that increase power, revitalize hit points, shield players from attacks and grant other mysterious effects.
 Pitball includes several gameplay options including Training, Single Game and Season modes. The Training mode is specifically designed for novice players and newcomers. Played on a holographic field, it teaches you the basics of gameplay. Whereas the Single Game is simply an exhibition match, the Season is a furious battle to the championship. There are also multi-player options including competitions for two, three and four players and a cooperative Versus mode. When more than two people are going to play, however, a Multi-Tap is needed.

Pop'n Pop is an arcade and console puzzle game by Taito Corporation. It has been ported to the PlayStation and Game Boy Color formats. The game featured characters from Taito games such as Rainbow Islands, Kiki Kaikai, Don Doko Don and The New Zealand Story,
 Based on the 1997 Taito arcade coin-op
 Gameplay:
 A collection of balloons are attached to clouds. The clouds move across the screen. When a column of balloons touches the edge of the screen, the clouds move down one level.
The player controls a familiar for his character, not your character him/herself. The familiar can release pairs of balloons towards the clouds. If a group of at least three similarly-colored balloons touch each other, they pop! The goal of the game is to clear the screen of all balloons.
 If the balloons do not touch the clouds, they continue up to the top of the screen and disappear. As a penalty, the clouds will temporarily speed up. The player usually doesn't want to miss the clouds, but sometimes it's a good idea to. Any balloons below balloons that pop move upward. The player can create combos by causing balloons to move up and form new similarly-colored groups of balloons, which will then pop too.
 Playstation game modes:
 - Story mode:
 Play through your choice of branching levels,facing a boss after every fifth level. Recover something for the princess from "Don Doko Don".Beating this allows you to use Chackn.
 The final boss is the Super Dark Great Dragon from Bubble Memories and Rainbow Islands. When you beat him, you have to fight him again as a Skel. As Super Dark Great Dragon, he shoots several laser beams you have to dodge. As Skel, he lowers EVERY cloud when he "jumps", not just one. You have to beat Skel quickly!
 - 1 Player vs computer:
 Beating this allows you to use Hipopo.
 - 1 Player vs 2nd Player
 - Family Mode, Challenge Mode & Checkmate mode.

Xako and Mia live for one thing and one thing only: to catch serious air performing mind-blowing stunts on their hoverdeks. A hoverdek is best described as a hovering skateboard, it works the same way but there are no wheels and it's constantly floating. Back to the story at hand, these two dekkies are fanatical about their skills; they would go adventuring with their buddies and show off new tricks.
 Would meaning past tense; dekkies are now being oppressed by the maniacal Krakken. With a sour hatred for hoverdeks, the cheese-smelling ingrate kidnaps dekkies and stores them in his mundane world. Xako and Mia are at the end of their ropes and decided that its time to destroy Krakken and rescue their fellow dekkies!
 Psybadek combines third-person 3D platforming with the trickery of a snow or skateboarding game. Spanning four unique worlds, players will overcome a series of platforming obstacles, pickup important items, and perform a barrage of death defying stunts aboard a hoverdek. Stunts include a ground-shaking SuperStomp, a 360-degree spiral, a circular back flip known as the Firewall, a near impossible spinning Powerblast, and a weather altering Elektra Storm.
 Broken into eight levels apiece (with a bonus level in each), the four worlds consist of an Ice World, a Jungle World, a Desert World, and the Underground. Level and world selection is chosen from the Psyba-Zone, which holds it all together as a hub. Each level features a unique design ranging from psychedelically rendered jungles to ancient temples.
 Krakken does not tolerate the insolent; anyone with enough guts to challenge him will be met with extreme resistance. His army consists of waddling penguins, genetically altered freaks that throw rocks and snowballs, and the ever-dangerous monkey. Fortunately, Xako and Mia are packing a few unique weapons such as the anti-matter missile, the C. King plastic explosive, and a Ballistic Bogey Bomb. They can also collect a number of stars that increase the overall score that awards the player with some extra goodies!
 Psybadek also features a few free-roaming areas and a local skate park when the going gets a little rough! So what are you waiting for? Grab your hoverdek, catch some massive air, and save your buddies from the evil Krakken!

El campo es pequeño, rodeado por un tablero a la altura de la cadera que los jugadores pueden usar para rebotar la pelota. Las reglas son simples: el juego comienza como en el baloncesto, con la pelota siendo dejada caer entre los dos delanteros en el medio del campo. El resto del juego es muy libre, con faltas otorgadas por desafíos torpes (se otorgarán penales si el jugador atacante está en el contraataque) y saques de banda (marcados con los pies) si la pelota supera los bordes. El jugador puede seleccionar la táctica: de los tres jugadores de campo (el portero no puede salir del área de gol), es posible jugar más ofensivamente (con 2 adelante y 1 atrás) o defensivamente (2 atrás y 1 adelante). meta.name: Puyo Puyo Box
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 51.26 MB

Puyo puyo Box features 5 different games inside! There is the original Puyo Puyo, the original Puyo Puyo Tsu, Single Player Puyo Puyo, Two Player Puyo Puyo, and Four Player Puyo Puyo.
 In 2000, Compile released an interesting little collection for the PSOne, called Puyo Puyo Box. It includes the Mega Drive versions of Puyo Puyo 1 and 2, along with some Pocketstation games and a four player mode (since this was absent from the PSOne version of Puyo Puyo 4.) None of this is really all that exciting, especially considering they could've ported the arcade versions, but the real highlight is the Quest Mode.
 The Quest Mode is a pure Puyo Puyo RPG. You don't fight enemies normally - you challenge them to a game of Puyo Puyo. Each battle nets you the usual gold and experience, which in turn can be used to upgrade your stats. Higher strength will inflict more nuisance puyos on your opponent, while higher defense will absorb some of your enemy's attacks. You have to be careful not to equip too much heavy equipment however, as they cause your blobs to fall pretty fast.
 The plot is the same "find a bunch of medals" stuff in the Madou Monogatari games, although there's plenty of goofiness abound. For example, Arle doesn't just open doors - she bashes through them, sending the door flying into the stratosphere. Naturally, this mode isn't terribly long, and the dungeons are fairly short and easy, but it's an innovative framework for the Puyo series. I don't see why they couldn't have used better graphics and music for the Quest Mode, especially considering this came out after Puyo Puyo 4 (the battles look/sound like the Puyo 2.) And the random battles can get annoying after awhile. You can run away from most weaker battles, but stronger enemies need to be fought - and since match lasts at least a minute or two, you'd better be in love with Puyo Puyo if you want to stick it through to the end.

A crossword is a word puzzle that normally takes the form of a square or rectangular grid of white and shaded squares. The goal is to fill the white squares with letters, forming words or phrases, by solving clues which lead to the answers. In languages that are written left-to-right, the answer words and phrases are placed in the grid from left to right and from top to bottom. The shaded squares are used to separate the words or phrases.
 Squares in which answers begin are usually numbered. The clues are then referred to by these numbers and a direction, for example, "4-Across" or "20-Down". At the end of the clue the total number of letters is sometimes given, depending on the style of puzzle and country of publication. Some crosswords will also indicate the number of words in a given answer, should there be more than one.
 Puzzle Mania features a numbers crossword puzzle game and assorted variants (Crossword Number Place, Skeleton Crossword & Number Crossword) which requires logic and quick thinking. Ply your guile on a 9x9 tiled board. The game features a complete tutorial in japanese.

QIX Neo es una nueva versión de Volfied, el juego de arcade de Taito de 1989. Los gráficos y los sonidos se actualizaron, pero la jugabilidad básica sigue siendo la misma, con el jugador controlando una pequeña nave moviéndose sobre una línea de contorno verde. La línea delgada se dibuja sobre los bordes de la pantalla, enmarcando el campo de juego. La nave actúa como un cursor y debe usarse para dibujar una extensión cuadrada o rectangular en el campo, eliminándola y disminuyendo lentamente el tamaño del espacio disponible. Los enemigos deambulan por cada nivel, moviéndose en patrones aleatorios por la pantalla pero siempre siguiendo los movimientos del cursor. La nave tiene un escudo de campo de fuerza a su alrededor y solo se vuelve vulnerable cuando se dibujan nuevas líneas. El jugador tiene que cerrar rápidamente las secciones, sincronizándolo correctamente para evitar la colisión con cualquiera de los enemigos o sus proyectiles. Los enemigos se pueden eliminar conectando una sección en la que están parados o usando uno de los potenciadores. Los power-ups se almacenan dentro de cajas, que en algunos niveles siguen apareciendo y desapareciendo, y se pueden recoger quitando una sección con uno de ellos dentro. La mayoría de los poderes son temporales, dan láseres para destruir a los alienígenas más pequeños, congelan a los enemigos durante unos segundos, aumentan la velocidad de la nave y ayudan de otras formas. Cada nivel se termina después de eliminar al menos el 70% del campo, o si el gran monstruo jefe que dispara a intervalos aleatorios muere de alguna manera. También se incluye un puerto del juego original, utilizando los activos antiguos pero con una orientación horizontal.

Cada uno de los pistas te llevará a través de una multitud de lugares antiguos, ciudades, maravillas naturales como faros, túneles, cascadas, ruinas, pueblos de estilo europeo, etc. Sin embargo, los gráficos se han transformado de goma de mascar como entornos poco realistas, monótonos y muy realistas. El deporte futurista de Rageball, inspirado en Speedball 2, es rápido, violento y mortal, se juega con equipos de exiliados convictos que no tienen nada que perder. Es el año 2612 y el deporte alcanzó un mínimo histórico. Por lo tanto, los prisioneros son enviados al planeta IS-326, conocido como "El Infierno", donde se les obliga a competir en un deporte violento, sin reglas. Eres gerente de un escuadrón de Rageball, ya que entrenas a los jugadores hacia la victoria del torneo, con decisiones tácticas y estratégicas.

Raiden DX es un shoot'em up arcade que sólo fue lanzado en Japón. El juego cuenta con desplazamiento vertical, similar a la de sus predecesores Raiden y Raiden II. Controla un avión de combate avanzado a través de diferentes etapas que se dividen en niveles.
Cuando destruye edificios y enemigos, puede recoger power-ups para conseguir mejores armas, bombas, misiles y ganar puntos extra. Hay tres modos, práctica, principiante y experto. Práctica cuenta con un solo nivel. Novato 5, y experto cuenta con los 8 niveles, incluidas las versiones remezcladas de los niveles principiante y práctica. Al final de cada zona, tiene que derrotar a un jefe.

El Proyecto Raiden presenta dos juegos de disparos de arcade de desplazamiento vertical en un disco: Raiden y Raiden II. Raiden tiene lugar en 2090, una época en la que la Tierra está siendo atacada por hordas de "seres exobiológicos extraterrestres, una raza de criaturas tecnológicamente avanzadas de una galaxia distante". Para combatir esta amenaza, los mejores científicos, ingenieros y personas brillantes del mundo han replicado un caza de gran altitud.

meta.name: Railroad Tycoon II

En Railroad Tycoon II, asume el papel del presidente de una compañía de ferrocarril, intentando obtener ganancias para los inversores y completando diversos objetivos, mientras que se ve obstaculizado por las empresas rivales, averías de trenes y asaltantes. La mayor parte del juego consiste en la construcción de vías, estaciones y trenes, que se utilizan para transportar mercancías de una estación a otra. El dinero recibido del transporte está determinado por la distancia entre las dos estaciones, la demanda y el valor de los bienes entregados, la mejora de la estación y el nivel de dificultad. El juego cuenta con una simulación de bolsa bastante compleja.

meta.name: Rakugaki Showtime
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.50 MB

Rakugaki Showtime you play as a rakugaki (scribble) character, who must fight against other rakugaki characters in a square 3D arena. The fights mainly consist of throwing items at the opposition. However, throwing is not as simple as "pick up, aim & throw". In Rakugaki Showtime different "drives" can be placed on the thrown items by holding different directions whilst throwing. Holding the direction towards the target will cause a "Forward Drive Throw", which is like a faster normal throw, albeit weaker. Holding the direction away from the target will cause you to do a "Backward Drive Throw", which will cause your character to throw the item slower and in an arc, but it will cause far more damage.

meta.name: Rally Cross 2
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 53.32 MB

La secuela de Rally Cross programada por Idol Minds, conservó el espíritu arcade de la primera entrega, con unos buenos gráficos, el juego ya no permitía jugar hasta 4 jugadores gracias al multitap, como ocurría en la primera parte, pero si se mantuvo el modo a 2 jugadores. Con respecto a la primera entrega, se agregó la capacidad de controlar aspectos previos del coche, como la suspensión, los neumáticos, la dirección, así como la capacidad de pintar el automóvil al que color que queramos.
El juego cuenta con 10 vehículos a elegir y 8 circuitos, que también cuenta con un editor interno, para poder crear tantos circuitos como queramos. Un juego muy divertido, que aunque no llegase a la calidad de V-Rally o Colin McRae Rally, es un juego a tener en cuenta dentro de los juegos de Rally en PlayStation.

Tú objetivo principal es destruir edificios, vehículos y combatir a las fuerzas militares que intentan detenerte. El juego tiene niveles situados en diferentes ciudades alrededor del mundo, como Londres, Tokio y París. Cada nivel está lleno de edificios destructibles, trampas y otros monstruos enemigos. Una de las características más destacadas es su modo multijugador, en el que hasta tres jugadores compiten entre sí para ver quién puede causar más destrucción.

meta.name: Rampage : Through Time

Como el título implica, Rampage Through Time añade un elemento de viaje en el tiempo. Sus mutantes sobredimensionados viajan a períodos de tiempo como el Viejo Oeste y la Edad Media, así como a otros períodos históricos más generales, como "zona de guerra", "extranjero" y "gángster".

meta.name: Kaisoku Tenshi
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 21.07 MB

The Rapid Angel puts you in the role of one off three characters Ayane who uses the sword and is the strongest one out of the group, Natsumi is the martial artist of the group and is able to pull off combos and Haruna who is a long-range combatant which is the most difficult of the three to use. Any character you choose will have a sequence of storyboards at the beginning, chances are you won't understand what they're saying but they are drawn nicely. All three characters play different in which they all attack and block but it's in the style of attacking that differs,when it comes to platforming they're very similar in how they jump. 
The game is a 2D platforming action game that circles around very simple controls. One assigned to jumping ( pressed twice to double jump), one assigned to attacking and one assigned to block that you will barely use, mostly because as in most games in this genre they don't usually use block so you'll forget it's an option. Last one is your ?magic? attack in which if pressed will attack everything on screen use it wisely because you only have so many. The controls works very well in that their easy to use, no complicated buttons to navigate through, just one button is all you really need. 
The style is very anime inspired. All the character have the big anime eyes and wacky anime emotions. Such as the over exaggerated expressions of waving their arms around very rapid when they are freaking out and the big sweat drops when they are in a nervous or awkward situation. Some of the environments will make you want to look around (usually the background) because of the detail. Later levels especially the lava ones look fantastic because of the glow in the environment.

PlayStation. Players choose one of ten available characters and races can take place on nine different tracks. En Rascal, debes rescatar a tu padre secuestrado, un profesor, de las garras del malvado Chronon. Chronon está usando al padre de Rascal para viajar en el tiempo y cumplir con sus malvados planes y depende de ti el detenerlo. Usted está armado con una pistola de burbujas para derrotar a los secuaces de Chronon mientras viaja a través del tiempo. Hay seis mundos para explorar que incluyen un castillo medieval, el salvaje oeste, la Atlántida, un barco pirata, la prehistoria y la dimensión del tiempo. Cada mundo tiene tres zonas horarias que cubren el pasado, el presente y el futuro.
En cada uno de esos niveles se monta una reloj de arena de seis piezas, que te teletransporta a casa.
